There's more to it. Whether you get it is another question.
Bold, asking for the rest. Give me a moment with that.
Mm. Not sure I've decided how much of it you get.
dialogue.conversations.fears.open.share: You too? Huh. It's less heavy when two people carry it.
dialogue.conversations.fears.open.share/: Strange comfort, that. Two cowards make one brave pair.
Then we watch each other's backs. That's how it's meant to work.
dialogue.conversations.fears.open.leave: Aye. Thank you for not making a thing of it.
dialogue.conversations.fears.open.leave/: Go on. It'll keep until next time, %1$s.
Right. Well. That's enough honesty for one afternoon.
dialogue.conversations.fears.open.pledge: ...Nobody's said that before. I'm holding you to it, %1$s.
Not alone. Right. I'll try to believe that.
Careful what you promise. I remember promises.
dialogue.conversations.fears.open.step_b: ...That's honest. I'd rather that than a promise you'd break.
Good. People promise too easily around here. Listening is enough.
No promises. Understood. You still stayed, though.
dialogue.conversations.fears.open.challe: ...Nobody ever offered the 'with you' part before. That's the part that matters. Alright. Next storm, I'll stand in the doorway.
You'd actually stand there with me. Huh. Fine. I'm holding you to it, and you're holding me to it.
Maybe. With a witness, maybe. Don't let me back out of it later.
You make it sound almost possible. Ask me again when it's close.
Easy for you — you've somewhere else to be when it goes wrong.
Hm. Half of me believes you. The other half keeps the accounts.
Don't make my fear a test of your character. It isn't yours to be brave about.
Face it, you say. You'll be gone by frost like everyone else.
Maybe I could. Not today, but maybe.
That's a thought I'll be carrying around now. Thanks for that.
You say it like it's simple. It might even be.
dialogue.conversations.fears.open.thank: Don't thank me. I didn't do anything except stop pretending for a minute.
dialogue.conversations.fears.open.thank/: It's not a gift, %1$s. It's just true. Still — aye. You're welcome.
Trust's a strange thing to be thanked for. I'll take it.
dialogue.conversations.fears.open.means: ...It did. More than I'd like to admit standing here.
dialogue.conversations.fears.open.means/: Getting it past my own teeth was the hard part. You just had to not flinch.
Noticed that, did you. Most don't.
dialogue.conversations.fears.open.close_: Aye. Go on. And %1$s — thank you.
Right. Enough of that. Mind how you go.
Off with you. We'll pretend this was about the weather.
dialogue.conversations.fears.pressed.bac: ...Thank you. Not many people can stop when they're told to.
That's the right answer, %1$s. I'll remember you gave it.
Good. The rest will come when it comes, or it won't.
dialogue.conversations.fears.pressed.pus: No. NO. You were told, and you asked again. Get away from me.
That's what you are, then. Someone who takes. I won't forget it, %1$s.
You cracked it open because you wanted to see. I hope it was worth the look.
dialogue.conversations.fears.pressed.lea: Go on, then. Before either of us says more.
dialogue.conversations.fears.guarded.res: ...Aye. It is mine. Thank you for hearing that the first time.
Most people push. You didn't. That buys you something, %1$s.
Good. Ask me again in a season and we'll see.
dialogue.conversations.fears.guarded.ask: Now that I can do. Ask me about the crops, or the roof, or the cat.
Something easier. Aye. Let's start there and work up.
Sensible. Small talk first, %1$s. That's how it's built.
dialogue.conversations.fears.guarded.pre: I said no. Do you want to hear it a second time?
You'll be wanting my savings next. It's a no, %1$s.
Pushing at a locked door only tells me about you.
dialogue.conversations.fears.guarded.lea: Off you go. No hard feelings.
Right you are. We'll get there or we won't.
dialogue.conversations.fears.scarred.apo: ...Took you long enough. It doesn't undo it. But it's something.
You were wrong, aye. Saying so out loud costs you something, so — noted.
I'll not pretend it never happened, %1$s. But you can stand there.
dialogue.conversations.fears.scarred.giv: Good. That's the only thing left that helps.
Aye. Space. I'd rather that than another apology.
Right. Come back in a week and ask me about the fence, and we'll see where we are.
dialogue.conversations.fears.again.apolo: It's alright. It's not the sort of thing that gets easier by repetition.
No harm. Ask me in a few days and I'll have found new words.
Appreciated, %1$s. Twice in a day is a lot to ask of anyone.
dialogue.conversations.fears.again.press: I already showed you that scar. Don't poke it twice in one week.
Twice? Buy me a drink first, %1$s.
Let it rest. It bites when it's poked fresh.
dialogue.conversations.fears.again.leave: Right. Catch me when the week's turned.
Good. Some things want a gap between them.
dialogue.conversations.fears.toddler.rea: You'd tell me if there WAS a monster though. Promise?
Okay. I feel a bit braver now.
dialogue.conversations.fears.toddler.ask: It's big. And it doesn't have a face. THAT'S the bad part.
It lives under there. Only at night. It's very rude.
I don't want to say it out loud. It might hear.
dialogue.conversations.fears.young.reass: ...Yeah. It is. Everyone acts like it's stupid.
Thanks. Most grown-ups just say 'don't be silly'.
dialogue.conversations.fears.young.norma: Everyone? Even you? ...Huh. That helps, actually.
So it's not just me being weird about it. Good.
Everyone's scared of something. I'll hold onto that.
dialogue.conversations.fears.young.dismi: Grow out of it. Sure. That's what people say when they've stopped listening.
dialogue.conversations.fears.young.leave: Alright. Don't tell anyone I said that.
dialogue.conversations.fears.plan.ask_wh: You remember all of it, don't you. Even the part I nearly didn't say. ...Company. That's what helps.
You remembered by morning. Nine in ten don't. Not being alone with it - that's the answer.
Since you actually listened the first time: someone knowing. That's most of it, %1$s.
Honestly? I don't know. Huh. That's a worse answer than I expected to give. Right - next question.
What would help. Huh. Give me a moment with that one.
Not being talked out of it, for a start.
dialogue.conversations.fears.plan.offer_: Do something about it. You make it sound like a chore list. ...Maybe it is.
Alright. Something small, then. I'm not promising heroics.
A plan. Aye - written down, in order, with a first step small enough to actually do, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.fears.plan.just_l: ...No plan. Just this. That's better than a plan, actually.
Everyone wants to fix it. You just stood there. Thank you.
Being here is the whole of it, some days.
dialogue.conversations.fears.plan.leave: Aye. It'll wait. It's good at waiting.
dialogue.conversations.fears.plan.leave/: Go on. We'll pick it up.
Right. Thank you for coming back to it at all.
dialogue.conversations.fears.followthrou: Slowly. But slowly is a direction, which is more than I had.
Two bad nights, one fine one. I'll take the arithmetic.
Better than it was. Ask me again next week and we'll see if I'm lying.
...It isn't nothing, is it. I keep telling myself it's nothing.
Don't make me proud of it, I'll get insufferable.
Someone noticing is half of why it worked, %1$s.
You did say that. And you turned up, which is the rarer half of a promise.
I know. I've been keeping the receipt, %1$s. You're square with me.
Not alone, you said. It turns out that was the useful bit.
You didn't promise anything. I remember. That's why I believed the rest of it.
You were honest instead of kind. It wore better than kind would have.
No promises from you, %1$s. And here you are anyway, asking.
Aye. Best not to stare at it too long.
Right. Off you go. It's still there, but it's smaller.
Go on. And thank you for keeping track.
dialogue.conversations.topic.checkin.goo: That's the shape of me lately.
dialogue.conversations.topic.checkin.rou: I'm listening, if you want to say more.
You'll be fine. You always are.
Tell me one thing I can take off you.
I'll stop asking. I'm around, though.
I've had a stretch like that myself.
dialogue.conversations.topic.checkin.goo: Good to hear. I'll get on.
Whatever you're doing, keep at it.
Things have been alright with me too.
dialogue.conversations.topic.checkin.you: Go on, tell me the whole thing.
That's not much of an answer.
dialogue.conversations.topic.checkin.aga: Sorry — I've asked you that already.
Humour me. Really, how are you?
dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough.lis: ...Alright. It's the hours, mostly. And nobody noticing them until now.
You'll actually wait for the answer. That's rarer than you'd think.
Then I'll say it: I'm tired in a way sleep doesn't fix.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough.ask: Nothing you could put on a list. It's the weight of the ordinary, mostly.
A few things. None of them the sort you can hand to someone else.
Ask me on a better day and I'd say nothing at all. Today — a fair bit.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough.dis: ...I will, yes. Thank you for the vote of confidence.
Always am. That's rather the problem, %1$s.
Mm. Suppose asking was the polite part and you've done it.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough.lea: Off you go. Thanks for stopping.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough.off: ...The wood, then. If you meant it. Tuesday, and bring the good axe.
One thing. You're the first to make it that easy to answer.
Hah. Alright. I'll think of something and hold you to it, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough.giv: That's the kindest version of leaving me alone I've heard.
Around, but not hovering. Aye. That's the useful kind.
Thank you. I'll come find you when I've words for it.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough.sha: You have? ...Then you know it isn't the sort of thing advice fixes.
Somebody else in the same boat. Strangely, that helps.
Good. Not good for you — you know what I mean, %1$s.
Everyone's had a stretch. I asked about mine.
Mm. And here I thought we were discussing me.
Right. Well. Glad you got through yours.
Everyone has, I suppose. Doesn't make it lighter, but it's company.
Aye. It goes round, doesn't it.
Then you'll know I'll be alright eventually. Eventually.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good.glad: Thank you. People check in when it's bad and vanish when it isn't.
Genuinely, you say. I'll take genuinely.
So am I, honestly. It's been a while.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good.ask_: Small things stacking the right way for once. That's all it takes.
Sleep, mostly. And nobody needing anything urgently.
The work's been going well, and that spills into everything else.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good.defl: You could have let me have the week.
Mm. There's a way of saying that which isn't a curse. That wasn't it.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good.leav: Aye, off you go. Enjoy yours.
Go on. I'll be here being suspiciously content.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good.keep: I intend to. Ask me again in a month and we'll see if I managed.
That's the plan. Plans and I have a history, mind.
Aye. Nice to be told to keep going rather than to slow down.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good.teas: Ruined already. Word'll be round the well by supper.
Hah! Don't you dare tell the baker. She'd never let it go.
A reputation for cheerfulness. The shame of it.
Must you? It was a nice moment.
I'm allowed a good week without commentary, %1$s.
Mm. And now I'm self-conscious about it. Well done.
Let them talk. I've had worse rumours.
It'll pass before anyone notices, I expect.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good.shar: Two of us doing alright at once. The village won't survive it.
Good. It's better when it's going round rather than pooling in one house.
Then we're both ahead. Let's not examine it too closely, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.young.int: The WHOLE thing? Right. Sit down.
Nobody ever asks for the whole thing! Okay, so —
You're going to regret that. It's a long one.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.young.enc: ...Am I? Don't say it in front of the others. ...But say it again sometime.
I am, aren't I! Mostly. Some days.
That's a good thing to hear before chores.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.young.dis: What did you want, a speech?
dialogue.conversations.checkin.young.lea: Okay. Come back later, I'll have news.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.again.apo: It's alright. Nice to be asked twice, honestly.
No harm in it, %1$s. My answer keeps.
Happens. I forget who I've told what, too.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.again.pre: The same as an hour ago. I'd tell you if it had changed.
Asking twice doesn't get you a different life, %1$s. Just a shorter answer.
...Fine. Still fine. That's the whole of it.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.again.lea: Go on. I'll have changed my answer by then, maybe.
So that's my lot at the table.
Anyway. You get used to it.
dialogue.conversations.topic.food.normal: That's what I'd pick, given the choice.
Food's food, but some of it's better.
Then that's how it is. No fuss from me.
How do you manage it, day to day?
Sounds like an excuse to be difficult.
I'll find you something you can actually eat.
There's food I can't touch either.
You don't have to explain it to me.
dialogue.conversations.topic.food.normal: Mine's plainer than that, I'll admit.
I'll let you get to your supper.
Humour me. What are you craving?
dialogue.conversations.food.trait.respec: ...Thank you. Most people want a reason, or a debate about it.
No fuss. Do you know how rare that is at a village table, %1$s?
Aye. It just is. Nice not to have to defend it for once.
dialogue.conversations.food.trait.ask_ab: Carefully, and with a lot of reading labels I can't always read.
You plan. Every meal, every feast day. It stops being a thought eventually.
Badly, some weeks. Well enough, most. Thanks for asking rather than guessing.
dialogue.conversations.food.trait.mock: ...It's not an excuse. It's my body, and it doesn't take requests.
dialogue.conversations.food.trait.mock/1: Difficult. Right. Come see me the night after I get it wrong, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.food.trait.mock/2: I'd swap with you gladly. Since I can't, I'll settle for you shutting up about it.
dialogue.conversations.food.trait.leave/: Right. Go and eat something I can't, %1$s.
Off you go. Mind the bakery, it's murder in there.
dialogue.conversations.food.trait.offer_: ...You'd actually do that? Nobody plans around me. Nobody.
That's a kindness with legs on it. Most kindness about this is just words.
I'll hold you to that, %1$s. And I'll be delighted about it.
dialogue.conversations.food.trait.share_: Is there? Then you know the look people give you at a feast.
Two of us dodging the same table. Solidarity.
Good. Not good — you know. It's easier having company in it.
dialogue.conversations.food.trait.let_be: Thank you. I've explained it four hundred times and it never gets shorter.
No, I don't. That's a small freedom, that.
Appreciated. Let's talk about literally anything else.
dialogue.conversations.food.normal.share: Plain's underrated. Plain is what you eat every day, and every day counts.
Then you'd get on with my mother. She thought seasoning was showing off.
Nothing wrong with plain, %1$s. Half the village pretends otherwise.
dialogue.conversations.food.normal.ask_r: Badly, is how. But I'll tell you the version I aim for.
Ha. You'd have to stand in my kitchen and watch. It doesn't write down.
Slowly, and with more butter than anyone admits to.
dialogue.conversations.food.normal.disag: Would you now. Go on then — defend your position.
Finally, someone with an opinion. Everyone else just nods at food.
Ha! Wrong, but I respect the conviction.
...It's only food, %1$s. It didn't need a counter-argument.
Right. Well. I'll keep my preferences to myself next time.
Everyone does. That's half the fun of the subject.
You'd be in good company. The whole village argues about it.
Fair enough. Wrong, but fair enough.
dialogue.conversations.food.normal.leave: Aye, off you go before we both get hungry.
Right. Mind the bakery queue at this hour, %1$s.
Go on. Eat something for me.
dialogue.conversations.food.normal.prais: Good taste, she says. I'll be insufferable for a week.
It's the only kind of taste I can afford, %1$s.
Hah. Tell that to my mother. She despairs of me.
dialogue.conversations.food.normal.promi: ...Would you? That's the nicest thing anyone's offered me this month.
I'll believe it when I'm chewing, %1$s. But I'll believe it.
Don't promise food you won't bring. I'll remember.
dialogue.conversations.food.normal.ask_w: The market, mostly. The good stall, not the loud one.
I grow half of it and beg the rest. It's an honest system.
There's a place. I'll tell you when I trust you not to clear them out.
dialogue.conversations.food.young.deligh: It IS! Everyone says it's not but it IS.
You get it! Nobody gets it!
dialogue.conversations.food.young.ask: Everything except the green ones. And the squishy ones.
dialogue.conversations.food.young.ask/1: Bread. Also bread. And sometimes bread.
dialogue.conversations.food.young.ask/2: Whatever's still warm when I get there.
dialogue.conversations.food.young.leave: Bye! I'm going to go eat.
dialogue.conversations.food.again.apolog: We did. Doesn't matter — I could talk about supper all day.
Twice is fine for this subject, honestly.
No harm. Ask me at mealtime and I'll have new opinions.
dialogue.conversations.food.again.press: Same as an hour ago, %1$s, and now I'm hungry about it.
dialogue.conversations.food.again.press/: You've made me think about bread again. That's on you.
...Bread. It's always bread. Are you satisfied?
dialogue.conversations.topic.weather.sto: It'll blow itself out. They always do.
Are you alright out in this?
It's only a bit of thunder.
Come sit it out with me.
I'll wait it out here with you.
Good weather for staying in bed.
dialogue.conversations.topic.weather.mil: It's a good one, isn't it.
Is it any use to the fields?
I could do with less of it, personally.
I'll make the most of it. Bye.
dialogue.conversations.topic.weather.tod: You're right - I can see it too.
What's your favourite kind of sky?
dialogue.conversations.weather.storm.con: ...I'm alright. Wet, but alright. Kind of you to check on a day like this.
Better for being asked, %1$s. Most folk run past in this.
I've been out in worse. Still — it's nice not to be invisible in the rain.
dialogue.conversations.weather.storm.pra: The washing, if you're offering. And the small hens panic at thunder.
Shutters on the north side. They rattle loose every single time.
Now that you mention it — yes. Two hands would halve it.
dialogue.conversations.weather.storm.dis: Tell that to the roof. And the animals. And my nerves.
A bit of thunder took the mill's roof off two winters back, %1$s.
Easy to say from under a hood. Go and stand in it a while.
dialogue.conversations.weather.storm.lea: Aye — you get in too. Mind the road, it floods by the gate.
Go on. Don't stand under the big elm, whatever you do.
Right. Dry socks and a door between you and it, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.weather.storm.off: ...I will, actually. Thank you. It's a long storm to sit through alone.
Somewhere dry and somebody in it. That's the whole of what I wanted.
Kind of you, %1$s. I'll bring what's left of the bread.
dialogue.conversations.weather.storm.sta: You'd wait it out here? Alright. It's better with company.
Suit yourself — but you'll be as soaked as I am.
That's decent of you. Storms are long when you're counting alone.
dialogue.conversations.weather.storm.jok: Ha! It is. Best weather there is, if you've nowhere to be.
Now there's a plan. Wake me when the sky's finished shouting.
You've got the right idea and the wrong job, %1$s.
Some of us can't. The animals don't care what the sky's doing.
Mm. I'd rather it stopped than be funny about it.
...Right. Very restful for you, I'm sure.
It would be, if the roof agreed.
If only. There's always something needs doing in it.
dialogue.conversations.weather.mild.enjo: It is. You have to say so out loud or the good days go by unremarked.
Aye. I'll be complaining about the heat by noon, but right now — aye.
Good of you to notice it. The sky mostly gets mentioned when it's against us.
dialogue.conversations.weather.mild.talk: Every bit of it. Another week like this and the barley's made.
Ask the farmer, she'll talk your ear off. Short answer: yes.
It'll do. We wanted rain a fortnight ago; now we want exactly this.
dialogue.conversations.weather.mild.grum: Ha! Finally, someone else who isn't delighted by it.
Aye, it's relentless. Nobody's allowed to say so.
Say that in the square and they'll look at you like you kicked a lamb.
Would you? It's the first decent day in a fortnight, %1$s.
There's no pleasing some people. It's a lovely morning.
Mm. And now I'm looking at it differently. Thanks for that.
Everyone wants a different sky. That's why nobody's ever happy.
Fair. It won't last either way.
You and half the village, then.
dialogue.conversations.weather.mild.leav: Aye. Get out in it while it holds.
Go on. It'll be raining by supper, mark me.
dialogue.conversations.weather.mild.agre: Course I am. I've been reading this sky since before you got here.
It's nice to be agreed with. Doesn't happen much around the well.
Aye. We'll be proved wrong by evening, but aye.
dialogue.conversations.weather.mild.ask_: Work, then more work, then sitting outside pretending I planned to.
Nothing grand. That's rather the luxury of a day like this.
Getting the outside jobs done before the sky changes its mind.
dialogue.conversations.weather.mild.cut_: ...It is only weather, aye. You brought it up, %1$s.
Right. I'll stop boring you with the sky, then.
dialogue.conversations.weather.toddler.p: YES! You SEE it! Grown-ups never look properly.
See? SEE? I told everyone and nobody listened to me.
I knew you'd get it. You're the only one who gets it, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.weather.toddler.a: The one with the pink bits at the end of the day.
Puddle sky! Best sky. You get puddles after.
Snow sky. It goes all quiet before.
dialogue.conversations.weather.toddler.l: Bye! I'm going to go look at them more.
dialogue.conversations.topic.season.holi: It comes round every year, and I still like it.
dialogue.conversations.topic.season.turn: The year turns whether we watch it or not.
dialogue.conversations.topic.season.holi: What do you do for it?
I can't make it, but enjoy it.
I'll let you get to it.
We did something similar where I'm from.
It's a lot of fuss, though.
dialogue.conversations.topic.season.turn: It suits you, this time of year.
I'll be glad when it's over.
I'll get on before the light goes.
Here's what I'm doing with it.
There's a lot to look forward to.
It's all the same to me.
I'll leave you to the weather.
dialogue.conversations.topic.season.todd: It's the best one, you're right.
What do you like about it?
dialogue.conversations.season.holiday.as: Same as we always have. Garlands, too much food, and someone crying by midnight.
The old way, mostly. My mother's way, if I'm honest, and hers before that.
You stand in the square until someone hands you a drink. It's a robust tradition.
dialogue.conversations.season.holiday.ac: ...I will. That's the first time anyone's asked to be counted in.
A place saved, then. Don't be late — the good bread goes early.
Done. And you'll be introduced to everyone, so brace yourself, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.season.holiday.de: Fair enough. It'll come round again — they always do.
Another year, then. I'll save you a story instead of a seat.
No matter. It's the asking that counts more than the coming.
dialogue.conversations.season.holiday.le: Aye — there's a great deal to do before dusk.
Go on. Come by the square later if you change your mind.
Right you are. Happy day to you, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.season.holiday.sh: Did you? Tell me — I collect other people's versions of this day.
Everywhere does it slightly wrong except here, obviously. Go on, though.
That's the good thing about the festivals. Everyone brings their own.
dialogue.conversations.season.holiday.co: We do, don't we. One day a season where nobody's counting the cost.
It's the one thing this village agrees on. Enjoy it while it lasts.
Kind of you to say. We work at it more than we let on.
dialogue.conversations.season.holiday.gr: It IS. Someone had to say it. Garlands don't hang themselves.
Ha! Every year I swear I'll do less and every year there's more.
A great deal of fuss for one evening. Worth it. Barely.
...It's the one good day, %1$s. Let us have it.
Fuss is the point. That's what a festival is.
Mm. You needn't come, you know.
Aye, but the alternative is an ordinary Tuesday.
A fair bit, yes. Somebody has to do the hanging.
dialogue.conversations.season.turn.agree: Does it? Huh. I'll take it. That's the first useful thing anyone's said about the weather.
It's the one I complain about least, so probably.
Aye, maybe. Something about it fits the way I work.
dialogue.conversations.season.turn.ask_f: The one just turning, usually. I'm easily persuaded by a change.
Autumn. Everything ripe at once and then the quiet after.
Whichever one isn't currently happening, if I'm honest.
dialogue.conversations.season.turn.compl: Aye! It goes on too long every single year and nobody admits it.
Thank you. Everyone else is being relentlessly cheerful about it.
Right there with you. Roll on the next one.
There's good in it if you look. I'd rather look.
Mm. Wishing a season away wishes the year away with it.
You and everyone. It'll turn soon enough.
It has its moments. Few of them, but it has them.
Aye, it drags. They all do by the end.
dialogue.conversations.season.turn.leave: Aye, the light goes early this time of year. Off you go.
Right you are. Mind the road, %1$s.
Go on. The year'll still be turning tomorrow.
dialogue.conversations.season.turn.share: Oh, tell me — I like knowing what people do with a season.
That's more of a plan than I've got. Mine is 'keep up'.
Good. A season with a plan in it goes faster and hurts less.
dialogue.conversations.season.turn.look_: There is, when you list it out like that. I forget to.
Aye. I'd stopped counting the good things. Thanks for the reminder.
You're a more hopeful sort than I am, %1$s. It's catching.
dialogue.conversations.season.turn.dismi: All the same. Right. I'll spare you the rest of my thoughts on it.
Mm. It isn't, but I'll not argue about weather.
dialogue.conversations.season.toddler.as: Everything! But mostly the smell. It smells different.
You get to do the thing! You know. The thing.
The food's better and nobody makes me go to bed on time.
dialogue.conversations.season.toddler.le: See you when it's the next one!
dialogue.conversations.topic.work.follow: So that's how the days go.
dialogue.conversations.topic.work.respon: You're good at what you do.
Why does it matter to you?
You don't sound like you enjoy it.
dialogue.conversations.topic.work.follow: Have you tried it the other way?
It sounds like it's wearing you down.
There's work, if you want it.
Anything I can help with regardless?
dialogue.conversations.topic.village.res: That's the place, for better or worse.
It's a good place to live.
What would you change about it?
dialogue.conversations.topic.village.fol: Tell me and I'll help fix it.
It could be run better, though.
dialogue.conversations.topic.village.non: That's a hard way to live.
dialogue.conversations.topic.village.you: It's a good village, isn't it.
dialogue.conversations.work.respond.prai: ...Am I? Twenty years and nobody's said it in those words. Thank you.
You'd be the first to notice. It's the joint people see, never the fitting of it.
I am, as it happens. It's good to be told once in a while, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.work.respond.ask_: Because somebody has to, and because it's mine. That's most of it.
Why. Hm. ...Because when it's done right it lasts longer than I will. Don't repeat that.
It's the one thing in the day nobody argues with me about.
dialogue.conversations.work.respond.chal: ...No. I don't, most days. You're the first to say it out loud.
Straight to it, then. Fine — no, I don't. Now what?
Blunt. Correct, but blunt. I'll answer it honestly since you asked honestly.
...That's a lot to read off a man doing his job, %1$s.
I never said that. You decided it for me.
Some of us just work. It doesn't have to be a wound.
Some days I don't. Most days it's just what I do.
Enjoy? No. But I'm good at it, and being good at a thing is its own sort of pleasure.
It pays, and the alternative is a winter I'd rather not think about.
dialogue.conversations.work.respond.leav: Right you are. Mind the tools by the door.
dialogue.conversations.work.followup.off: ...Huh. That'd work. Where were you three winters ago?
I've done it my way so long I stopped looking. Say it again slowly.
Not bad. I'll try it and blame you loudly if it goes wrong.
dialogue.conversations.work.followup.hea: ...It is. Huh. Everyone else asks when it'll be finished. Right - where were we.
Wearing me down. Aye, that's the word for it. I'd not found the word.
You've been watching, then. It's the work that gets seen, not the man doing it.
dialogue.conversations.work.followup.bel: Anyone could. Nobody does. There's a difference, %1$s.
Then take the tools. Go on. I'll watch.
...Right. I'll remember that next time you need something mended.
dialogue.conversations.work.young.encour: It IS! Nobody counts it but it is.
...Thanks. Everyone calls it helping. It's work.
You get it. Grown-ups usually don't.
dialogue.conversations.work.young.ask: My mother, mostly. And a lot of getting it wrong first.
dialogue.conversations.work.young.ask/1: Nobody! I watched until I worked it out.
dialogue.conversations.work.young.ask/2: The smith lets me hold things. That counts as teaching, I reckon.
dialogue.conversations.work.young.dismis: Everyone says that until they need it done.
dialogue.conversations.work.young.leave/: Okay. I've got things to finish.
dialogue.conversations.work.again.apolog: No harm. I like talking about it more than I let on.
You did ask, aye. My answer keeps.
It's alright, %1$s. It's the only subject I'm expert in.
dialogue.conversations.work.again.press: It's the same trade it was an hour ago.
dialogue.conversations.work.again.press/: Twice? The work hasn't changed, %1$s, and neither have I.
...Fine. Same as before. Now let me get on.
dialogue.conversations.work.again.leave: Aye. Come back when I've something new to show you.
dialogue.conversations.work_offer.ask_ne: Straightforward enough. I'll show you the whole of it if you're in.
Nothing heroic. It's the sort of thing that just needs doing.
More than I can manage alone, which is why I'm asking.
dialogue.conversations.work_offer.ask_te: Fair question. I'd ask it too. You'll be paid properly, %1$s.
Straight to the terms. Good — I'd rather deal with someone who asks.
Whatever's fair. I'll not have it said I short anyone.
dialogue.conversations.work_offer.accept: Then let's talk properly about it.
Good. Come here and I'll lay it out.
That's settled, then. Here's the detail.
dialogue.conversations.work_offer.declin: No matter. The asking wasn't a debt.
Fair enough. It'll keep till someone's free.
Understood. Come back if that changes, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.work_offer.refuse: There was no call for that. It was only a job.
Noted. I'll not trouble you again.
dialogue.conversations.work_offer.leave: Take your time. It'll wait a day.
dialogue.conversations.work_offer.leave/: Right you are. Think on it.
dialogue.conversations.work_offer.none.o: ...That's decent of you. There's always something, if you're offering.
Nothing paid, but I'll not turn down a spare pair of hands.
You'd help with no job in it? That's rarer than a quest, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.work_offer.none.a: Do. Things pile up faster than I'd like.
Aye, check back. There's always something by week's end.
I'll have something for you soon enough.
dialogue.conversations.village.respond.a: It is. Small, loud, and mine. I'd not swap it.
Aye. You'll not hear that said often, but aye.
Good of you to say. Most visitors count the mud and leave.
The well, first. Then the road. Then whoever decided where the pigs go.
Asked as though the answer mattered. ...The road, then. The road, and I'll show you where.
A dozen things. Most of them small, all of them years old.
dialogue.conversations.village.respond.i: ...It's my home, %1$s. Say that somewhere else.
Miserable. Right. And yet here you are, in it.
Everyone here has built something. You've walked through it.
dialogue.conversations.village.respond.l: Aye. Mind the mud by the well.
Off you go. It'll be here.
...You'd actually put a hand to it? Opinions I get plenty of. Hands, not so much.
Then you're worth more to this place than half the people born in it.
Careful — say that where the mayor hears and you'll have a job for life.
It could. Somebody had to say it plainly and nobody would.
Aye. Badly, in places. You'll not offend me with the truth.
Finally. I've been saying it at the well for a year.
Easy to say, passing through. We're the ones living in it.
...Perhaps. It's still ours to criticise, not yours.
Run it better how? Everyone has a plan until it's their turn.
Most places could. Ours no worse than most.
Aye, probably. Nothing's run as well as it looks from outside.
There's truth in that. There's truth in most complaints here.
Good. Then you've been paying attention.
Aye. It's nice to be agreed with about home.
Right. Don't tell the mayor I said it.
dialogue.conversations.village.none.symp: ...It is. Thank you for calling it what it is instead of a choice.
Hard's the word. Everyone else says 'free', as though that were the same.
Aye. Kind of you to notice it without making it a lesson.
dialogue.conversations.village.none.ask_: Wherever the roof holds. It changes with the season.
Here and there. I'd rather not be more exact than that, %1$s.
Nowhere with a name. Ask me again when it does have one.
dialogue.conversations.village.none.dism: ...My fault. Right. You know nothing about it, %1$s.
There's a lot you're assuming there. Most of it wrong.
Aye, well. Easy judgement is cheap and you got it free.
dialogue.conversations.village.young.pla: It IS. There's a bell and everything.
Best village. I've only seen the one, but still.
dialogue.conversations.village.young.ask: The well. You can shout into it.
Market day. Everyone's out and nobody's counting where I am.
The big tree. It's mine, mostly.
dialogue.conversations.village.again.apo: No harm. I'd talk about this place all day.
You did, aye. It hasn't moved since.
dialogue.conversations.village.again.pre: Same village it was this morning.
It hasn't improved in an hour, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.topic.people.foll: You live alongside them either way.
dialogue.conversations.topic.people.resp: They're not so bad, most of them.
dialogue.conversations.topic.people.foll: Have you tried talking to them?
dialogue.conversations.topic.people.youn: Who do you get on with?
dialogue.conversations.topic.rumors.foll: So. What do we do with that.
dialogue.conversations.topic.rumors.none: Good. A quiet week suits me.
dialogue.conversations.topic.news.sad.re: That's the news, and it's not good.
dialogue.conversations.topic.news.follow: So that's the village this week.
dialogue.conversations.topic.news.glad.r: Good to hear. I'll get on.
I hope it works out for them.
dialogue.conversations.topic.news.follow: I'll not repeat any of it.
And how are you, with all that?
dialogue.conversations.topic.news.none.r: I've had a week of it myself.
dialogue.conversations.topic.noticed.gri: It's been a heavy few days here.
I'll not make you talk about it.
dialogue.conversations.topic.noticed.ann: I'm sorry for what I did.
dialogue.conversations.topic.noticed.ela: It's good to see you like this.
dialogue.conversations.noticed.annoyed: You. Right. What is it you want, %1$s?
dialogue.conversations.noticed.annoyed/1: I'm still sore about it, if you must know.
dialogue.conversations.noticed.annoyed/2: In myself? Irritated. Mostly at you, since you asked.
dialogue.conversations.people.respond.ag: Then it isn't just me. That's a relief, honestly.
You've seen it too. Nobody says it out loud around here.
Aye. Good neighbours, mostly. Mostly is doing some work in that sentence.
dialogue.conversations.people.respond.de: ...You're right. I'm being unfair and you said so kindly.
Somebody had to say it back to me. They're not so bad.
Fair. I'd rather be corrected than agreed with out of politeness.
Easy to defend people who've never crossed you.
They're not, mostly. I'm just tired of them this week.
True enough. Everyone's someone's difficult neighbour.
Aye. I say worse than I mean.
dialogue.conversations.people.respond.as: You want the specifics. Alright — but this stays here.
One example. Just one, or we'll be here till dark.
Ha. How long have you got, %1$s?
dialogue.conversations.people.respond.le: Wise. Nothing good comes of stirring it.
Right you are. Mind who you repeat things to.
dialogue.conversations.people.followup.e: ...It is. Living beside people is the whole job, some weeks.
Exhausting is the word. Thank you for not telling me to be patient.
You'd think a small village would be less work. It's more.
...No. I've been avoiding it for a season. Maybe I should.
Talking. There's a thought. Everyone here prefers a grudge.
You make it sound simple. It might even be.
dialogue.conversations.people.followup.p: ...No. I've said more than I meant to already.
I'll not name names to someone who asks like that, %1$s.
That's not what this was. Let it lie.
dialogue.conversations.people.young.list: The baker's lad, mostly. And the dog. The dog counts.
Most people. Not the one who shouts at the well.
Nobody my age, really. That's the trouble with here.
dialogue.conversations.people.young.ask: ...Not unkind. Just busy. It's a bit the same, though.
dialogue.conversations.people.young.ask/: One person. But I'm not saying who.
dialogue.conversations.people.again.apol: You did, aye. They've not changed since.
dialogue.conversations.people.again.pres: Twice in a day is how rumours start, %1$s.
...Fine. Still difficult. Still mine to live beside.
dialogue.conversations.rumors.respond.as: ...Fair question. Second-hand, if I'm honest. Maybe third.
Nobody ever asks that. Which is rather how these things spread.
The well, where else. Which means it's half invented already.
dialogue.conversations.rumors.respond.ch: ...No. It doesn't, does it. I repeated it without thinking.
You're right to doubt it. I doubted it and said it anyway.
Reliable's a strong word for anything said near that well.
dialogue.conversations.rumors.respond.li: Right. Well. There's not much more, when I say it aloud.
That's most of it. It sounded bigger in my head.
You're an easy person to tell things to. Dangerous, that.
dialogue.conversations.rumors.followup.p: ...Thank you. That's not nothing, around here.
It stops with you. Good. I'd rather it had stopped with me.
I'll hold you to that, %1$s. People here rarely mean it.
dialogue.conversations.rumors.followup.l: Aye. Best forgotten. I'll try to.
You're right. It doesn't deserve the air.
Good. Let it die at this well and not the next.
dialogue.conversations.rumors.followup.e: I'd rather not add to it. And now I wish I'd said nothing.
You want the list. That tells me something about you.
dialogue.conversations.rumors.none.relie: It does me too. Quiet weeks are underrated.
Aye. Nothing to repeat means nothing went wrong.
Good. Long may it stay dull, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.rumors.none.ask_a: Nothing worth your time. And I'd tell you if there were.
Not a whisper. Come back after market day.
dialogue.conversations.news.sad.compassi: ...Not well. Nobody is. Thank you for asking after them and not the details.
Badly. But somebody asking helps more than you'd think, %1$s.
As you'd expect. We're carrying it between us, which is how it's done here.
dialogue.conversations.news.sad.ask_more: There's not much more to it, and what there is I'd rather not.
You'll hear the rest from someone. I'd rather it not be me.
Quietly, in the night. That's all anyone needs to know.
dialogue.conversations.news.sad.amused/1: Somebody died, %1$s. Somebody we all knew.
dialogue.conversations.news.sad.amused/2: I'll pretend I didn't hear that. Don't make me hear it twice.
dialogue.conversations.news.sad.leave: Aye. Not a day for talking.
dialogue.conversations.news.sad.leave/1: Go on. Thank you for stopping.
dialogue.conversations.news.glad.celebra: Isn't it! The whole square's been insufferable about it, in the best way.
It is. We needed one of those, honestly.
Good news travels twice as fast here, and it deserves to.
dialogue.conversations.news.glad.ask_mor: Gladly. Sit down, this is the good version.
Ha! You'll get the long telling, then. Stop me when you've had enough - people usually do.
Everyone's got a piece of it. Here's mine.
dialogue.conversations.news.glad.sour: ...Must you. Let it be good for a week.
dialogue.conversations.news.glad.sour/1: Maybe not. But it's good today, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.news.glad.sour/2: That's a bleak way to take good news.
dialogue.conversations.news.glad.leave: Aye! Go and hear the rest from someone livelier.
dialogue.conversations.news.glad.leave/1: Right you are. Good day for it.
dialogue.conversations.news.mixed.curiou: Nobody's quite sure. That's half of why it's being talked about.
Work, most likely. It usually is, round here.
You'd have to ask them. Nobody has, which is very us.
dialogue.conversations.news.mixed.wish_w: So do I. It's a strange thing, watching people go.
Kind of you. Half the village is placing bets instead.
Aye. Whatever it is, I hope it works out.
dialogue.conversations.news.mixed.skepti: There is. There always is. You've a good nose, %1$s.
Aye — I thought the same and said nothing. Good to hear it said.
Ha. You've been here long enough to be suspicious. That's progress.
Maybe there is. It's not ours to dig at.
That's how half the unkind stories here start.
Could be. I'd not want to guess at it aloud.
dialogue.conversations.news.mixed.leave: Aye. You'll hear more soon enough.
dialogue.conversations.news.followup.kee: ...Thank you. That's worth more than you know in a place this size.
Good. I told you, not the village.
I'll remember you said that, %1$s. People here rarely do.
dialogue.conversations.news.followup.ask: ...Me? I'm — thank you. I'm alright. And you? You get to answer that too, %1$s.
You asked about me, not the story. That's unusual.
Tired of carrying other people's news, if I'm honest.
dialogue.conversations.news.followup.spr: ...Should they. It isn't ours to hand round, %1$s.
That's how it becomes something worse than it was.
I'd rather it stopped here. Clearly you would not.
dialogue.conversations.news.followup.lea: Aye. Enough of other people's business.
dialogue.conversations.news.none.chat_an: It does. A week with no news is a week nobody was hurt.
Aye. I'll take dull over interesting most years.
That's a kind way to put an empty week, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.news.none.share_o: Have you? Go on then — you're the news this week.
Then tell me yours. Somebody should have something.
Ha. Between us we might manage one piece of gossip.
dialogue.conversations.news.none.leave: Aye. Come back after market day.
...Aye. I am allowed, aren't I. Nobody's said that.
Everyone's telling me to be strong. You didn't. Thank you.
Allowed. That's the whole of what I needed to hear, %1$s.
Thank you. Everyone wants the story. You didn't ask for it.
That's a kindness. I'll come find you when I can say it.
Good. Sitting here quietly is the most anyone's helped this week.
That's life. Aye. Say that to the family.
I know people die. I knew this one.
Aye. Thank you for stopping at all.
Go on. It's not a day for company.
dialogue.conversations.noticed.annoyed.a: ...Right. That's more than I expected. It helps.
An actual apology. Huh. Alright — we're not square, but we're closer.
I'll take it, %1$s. Don't make me need another.
dialogue.conversations.noticed.annoyed.e: Go on then. I'll hear it, which is more than I meant to offer.
An explanation isn't an apology. But I'm listening.
dialogue.conversations.noticed.annoyed.b: Still on about it. Yes. That tends to happen, %1$s.
You've a short memory for your own behaviour.
Then we've nothing to discuss. Good day.
dialogue.conversations.noticed.elated.sh: It's good to BE like this. It's been a while, %1$s.
Ha! Don't get used to it. But thank you.
Somebody noticing makes it better, oddly.
dialogue.conversations.noticed.elated.as: The whole village, really. Good weeks are contagious here.
A few things at once. I've stopped questioning it.
You'll have heard. Everyone has. It's that sort of village.
dialogue.conversations.noticed.elated.de: ...I'll get carried away if I like, thank you.
Must you. It's been a good week and you've dented it.
Noted. I'll be measured about my own happiness in future.
dialogue.conversations.noticed.fine.glad: It isn't, is it. Steady's the best most weeks manage.
Aye. I'll take steady over interesting.
Kind of you to count it as something.
dialogue.conversations.noticed.fine.dig: ...Mostly. There's a thing, but it's small and it'll keep.
dialogue.conversations.noticed.fine.dig/: You're not letting that pass, are you. ...No. Not entirely.
Really. Ask me again in a week and I might have a longer answer.
dialogue.conversations.noticed.fine.dism: ...You asked how I was. That's how I am.
Not everything needs to be a story, %1$s.
...Nobody asks it like that. Give me a day and I'll have an answer.
What would help. Huh. Nothing dramatic — just what you're doing now.
Company, mostly. You've supplied it, so — done.
That's the useful kind of promise. Thank you.
Around. Aye. That'll do more than advice would.
Good. I'll hold you to being nearby, %1$s.
Aye, let's. I've worn that one out.
Good idea. Tell me something ordinary.
Aye. Thank you for asking at all.
dialogue.conversations.topic.people.foll: Best I stay out of it.
dialogue.conversations.topic.life.guarde: Some things stay mine for now.
Come on, you can tell me.
dialogue.conversations.life.guarded.resp: ...Thank you. Most want the ending first and lose interest before the middle.
Aye. You'll get it in pieces, in the order it happened, if you're still about, %1$s.
Good. It's a long story and it's better told to somebody who isn't in a hurry.
dialogue.conversations.life.guarded.ask_: The recent parts you can have. It's the old ones that cost something to hand over.
Ask me about this year. This year I can do standing up, %1$s.
Something from the shallow end of it, aye. There's plenty there worth telling.
dialogue.conversations.life.guarded.pres: You want the whole of it before you've been told the first page. It doesn't work that way.
A life isn't a thing you get handed, %1$s. It's a thing you're let into, slowly.
No. Ask me what I did yesterday and I'll answer. Ask me what made me, and we're not there.
dialogue.conversations.life.guarded.leav: Off you go. We'll get there or we won't.
dialogue.conversations.life.again.apolog: It's alright. It's a long story and I'd only have started it in the wrong place anyway.
No harm, %1$s. It's not as though the past has gone anywhere since this morning.
Happens. I've told bits of it to so many people I lose track of who has which bit.
dialogue.conversations.life.again.press/: Twice in a day is a lot to ask of a person, %1$s.
...Fine. But you'll get the abridged version.
dialogue.conversations.life.again.leave: Aye. Catch me later in the week.
dialogue.conversations.life.young.intere: Really? Right — nobody ever asks for the long version.
You want to hear it properly? Alright!
Sit down, then. This takes a minute.
dialogue.conversations.life.young.encour: It IS worth having. Thanks for saying it.
Hm. Alright. Don't make a speech about it or I'll take it back.
dialogue.conversations.life.young.dismis: Everyone says that. Everyone's wrong so far.
dialogue.conversations.topic.dreams.guar: Some things stay mine for now.
Come on, you can tell me.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.guarded.re: ...Thank you. It's easier to keep building when nobody's stood over it judging the shape.
Aye. Ask me again when there's something to actually look at, %1$s.
Good. Half-built things don't survive an opinion.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.guarded.as: Ask me what I did today. That one's free and it's mostly fence posts.
The small wants I'll give you. It's the big one I'm keeping under a cloth, %1$s.
Something I've already done, then. Those are finished and safe to look at.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.guarded.pr: Said out loud too early, a thing like that goes flat. I've watched it happen.
You want to hear it so you can tell me whether it's sensible. I know how this goes, %1$s.
No. It's half-built. Nobody gets shown a house with no roof on it.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.guarded.le: Off you go. We'll get there or we won't.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.again.apol: It's alright. Saying it twice in a day makes it sound less likely, that's all.
No harm, %1$s. It hasn't moved on since breakfast, but I appreciate the interest.
Happens. I'd rather be asked twice than not at all, if I'm honest.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.again.pres: Same one as this morning. It's not the sort of thing that gets a new version by noon.
You'll get the same answer with less enthusiasm, %1$s. That's what asking twice buys you.
...Fine. But if it sounds smaller this time that's your doing, not mine.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.again.leav: Aye. Catch me later in the week.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.young.inte: Really? Alright - so it's got three parts and the third one's the good one.
You want the WHOLE plan? Nobody wants the whole plan. Sit down.
Right. It starts small and it gets very big by the end. Don't laugh at the middle.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.young.enco: ...You think I could? Most people say 'we'll see' in the voice that means no.
I COULD, couldn't I. I'm going to remember you said that.
That's the first time anyone's said it back without the face. Thanks, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.young.dism: ...Everyone says that. Everyone said it to everyone who ever did anything, too.
You don't know that. Nobody knows that yet, including me.
Fine. Then I'll do it and not tell you about it.
dialogue.conversations.topic.hopes.guard: Some things stay mine for now.
Come on, you can tell me.
dialogue.conversations.hopes.guarded.res: ...Thank you. Ask me again after harvest and we'll see what's left standing.
Aye. It'll either happen or it won't, and talking at it does neither, %1$s.
Good. Let it stay a hope a while longer. They keep better unspoken.
dialogue.conversations.hopes.guarded.ask: Ask me about the weather. Hopes and weather are cousins - neither improves for being discussed.
The small hopes you can have. Supper. A dry week. Those I'll say out loud, %1$s.
Something with less riding on it, aye. That I can manage.
dialogue.conversations.hopes.guarded.pre: Don't. Say a hope out loud to the wrong person and it turns into a promise you owe them.
I'm superstitious about it and I'll not be argued out of that, %1$s.
No. Naming it is how you jinx it. My grandmother said so and I've seen nothing to disprove her.
dialogue.conversations.hopes.guarded.lea: Off you go. We'll get there or we won't.
dialogue.conversations.hopes.again.apolo: It's alright. Hopes don't change between morning and afternoon, more's the pity.
No harm, %1$s. Ask me tomorrow and there might even be news.
Happens. It's a nice thing to be asked about, even twice.
dialogue.conversations.hopes.again.press: Same hope. Hopes are slow. That's rather the point of them.
Nothing's changed since you last asked, %1$s. That's not a complaint, it's a harvest.
...Fine. Still hoping. There, you've had it twice and it's twice as true.
dialogue.conversations.hopes.again.leave: Aye. Catch me later in the week.
dialogue.conversations.hopes.young.inter: Really? Okay - it's only a little one but it's the one I keep checking on.
You want to hear the whole list? There's a list. It's longer than you'd think.
Right, sit down, because some of them are years away and I've thought about all of them.
dialogue.conversations.hopes.young.encou: ...You hope so too? Then that's two of us and it's twice as likely. That's how it works.
It IS going to happen. Probably. Thanks for saying it might, %1$s.
Nobody usually hopes along with me. They just say 'that'd be nice' and change the subject.
dialogue.conversations.hopes.young.dismi: ...It's not silly. It's just not YOURS, so it looks silly from over there.
You'd hope for it too if it was yours to hope for.
dialogue.conversations.topic.regrets.gua: Some things stay mine for now.
Come on, you can tell me.
dialogue.conversations.regrets.guarded.r: ...Thank you. It isn't a thing that improves with an audience.
Aye. You'll get it the day I can say it without my voice doing that, %1$s.
Good. Not everything wants digging up to be looked at.
dialogue.conversations.regrets.guarded.a: Anything that isn't behind me. The front of my life is perfectly good company.
Ask me about now. Now I've made my peace with, %1$s.
Something I'd not have to apologise for, then. That narrows it, but not to nothing.
dialogue.conversations.regrets.guarded.p: You're asking me to lift a stone I put down on purpose. Leave it where it is.
That door stays shut, %1$s, and it isn't shut because I forgot about it.
No. Some things you tell people once they've seen you at your worst and stayed. Not before.
dialogue.conversations.regrets.guarded.l: Off you go. We'll get there or we won't.
dialogue.conversations.regrets.again.apo: It's alright. It isn't the sort of thing that gets lighter for a second telling.
No harm, %1$s. Once a day is already more than I usually manage.
Happens. I'd sooner you forgot you asked than remembered what I answered, truthfully.
dialogue.conversations.regrets.again.pre: Same one. There's only ever been the one, which is either lucky or very unlucky.
Twice in a day is a lot to ask of that particular subject, %1$s.
...Fine. The short version, and then we're done with it for today.
dialogue.conversations.regrets.again.lea: Aye. Catch me later in the week.
dialogue.conversations.topic.secret.guar: Some things stay mine for now.
Come on, you can tell me.
dialogue.conversations.secret.guarded.re: ...Thank you. People usually take a 'not yet' as a challenge.
Aye. Ask me again when we've more winters between us, %1$s.
Good. That's how it stays worth telling later.
dialogue.conversations.secret.guarded.as: Now that I can do. Ask me anything that isn't underneath.
Something lighter. Aye — we'll build up to the rest.
dialogue.conversations.secret.guarded.pr: I could. I'm choosing not to. There's a difference.
Pushing at that door tells me more about you than it opens, %1$s.
No. Not for the asking, and not for asking twice.
dialogue.conversations.secret.guarded.le: Off you go. We'll get there or we won't.
dialogue.conversations.secret.again.apol: It's alright. It's not the sort of thing that improves by repetition.
No harm, %1$s. Ask me in a few days.
Happens. I lose track of what I've said to whom, too.
dialogue.conversations.secret.again.pres: Same answer, and quieter this time, because the walls haven't moved either.
One a season, I said. Asking twice in a day is how people end up with nothing, %1$s.
...Fine. But you're getting the small one, and you're not getting another for a while.
dialogue.conversations.secret.again.leav: Aye. Catch me later in the week.
dialogue.conversations.topic.life.respon: That's the shape of it, more or less.
dialogue.conversations.topic.life.follow: So that's where I came from.
dialogue.conversations.arc.life.resume.r: You remember what I told you.
dialogue.conversations.topic.life.respon: Which part matters most to you?
You could have done better than that.
dialogue.conversations.topic.life.follow: Tell me more about that part.
Something like that happened to me.
That's a life, right enough. I'll go.
dialogue.conversations.arc.life.resume.r: And where does that leave you now?
It was a long time ago.
dialogue.conversations.life.respond.ask_: Which part. Nobody asks that — they just want the whole thing at once.
...The middle. The bit I usually skip. You've a good instinct, %1$s.
Good question. Give me a moment to choose honestly.
dialogue.conversations.life.respond.empa: It wasn't. Thank you for saying so instead of telling me it built character.
No. And most people hear it and change the subject.
...Aye. It's strange, being allowed to say that out loud.
dialogue.conversations.life.respond.judg: ...I was fourteen, %1$s. What exactly should I have done better?
Everyone could have done better. That's what a life is.
I told you that in confidence, not for marking.
dialogue.conversations.life.respond.leav: Aye. It's not a short story and you've things to do.
Go on. Thank you for asking at all, %1$s.
Right. That's enough of my history for one day.
dialogue.conversations.life.followup.fol: ...Alright. You want the next part. Huh. Right, then. Here it is.
You're the first to ask twice. That's how you get the real version.
Then you'll hear the bit I keep back. Don't make me regret it, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.life.followup.com: Did it? Then you'll know why I've never made much of it.
Two of us, then. It helps, oddly, knowing that.
Tell me yours some time. Fair's fair, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.life.followup.cha: Aye, let's. I've dug enough for one afternoon.
Good. It gets heavier the longer you hold it up.
Right. Ask me about the weather and we'll both recover.
dialogue.conversations.life.resume.ask_c: You remembered which part. ...Alright. Here's how it ended.
You remembered it overnight. Not everyone would. That earns you the rest.
The very part I nearly didn't tell you. Fine — the ending, then.
There's more to it, aye. Where were we?
I did leave it half-told, didn't I.
The rest isn't as good as the beginning. But you can have it.
dialogue.conversations.life.resume.ask_n: Where it leaves me. Huh. Better than it left me then, I think.
Standing here, mostly. That's the honest answer, %1$s.
Further along than I was. That's all anyone manages.
dialogue.conversations.life.resume.brush: ...It was. And you asked me to tell it, so.
Aye. I'll not bring it up again, if that's what you'd prefer.
dialogue.conversations.life.resume.leave: Aye. It'll keep — it has this long.
Go on, %1$s. Thank you for coming back to it.
dialogue.conversations.arc.dreams.resume: That thing I told you I wanted.
dialogue.conversations.topic.dreams.resp: That's a long way from here.
dialogue.conversations.topic.dreams.foll: I can't promise help. But I'm glad you told me.
dialogue.conversations.arc.dreams.resume: What's the first step? I'll help with that.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.respond.en: ...Should I? Saying it out loud to someone makes it feel less daft.
Everyone else tells me to be sensible. You're the first who didn't.
Chase it. Right. I'll think about what that would even look like.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.respond.as: You want the details? Nobody wants the details.
Right — so it starts with the workshop, and gets ambitious from there.
Careful. Ask twice and you'll get the whole plan, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.respond.re: It is. That's the useful thing to hear and nobody says it.
A long way. Aye. Better to know the distance than pretend there isn't one.
Straight with me. Good. I'd rather that than encouragement I can't use.
...I know how far it is. I didn't need it measured out.
Thank you. I'd almost forgotten to feel small about it.
Everything's a long way from here, %1$s. That's the point of wanting it.
It is a long way. I've counted the steps more than once.
Aye. Doesn't stop it being the thing I want.
True enough. Most worthwhile things are.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.respond.le: So do I. Thank you for not laughing at it.
Right. Back to the actual day, then.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.followup.p: ...You mean that? Then it's the first time it's been more than mine.
Careful what you promise, %1$s. I'll hold you to it and I'll enjoy it.
Help. Right. Then you can start by holding the other end of things while I swear at them.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.followup.b: That's better than a promise you'd break. Thank you for the honesty.
Glad I told you. That's enough on its own, most days.
No promises. Good. I've had promises. I'd rather have the truth.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.followup.m: ...Yes. Me. Doing that. Thank you for the vote of confidence, %1$s.
I'll not mention it again. To you, anyway.
That's the reaction I was afraid of. Well done.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.resume.ask: You said you'd help, and you came back to ask. That counts for a great deal.
Closer, aye — partly because somebody was going to ask me.
I've moved on it. I'd not have, if you hadn't offered, %1$s.
A little. Slowly. But you asking is more than most do.
Not much. It's still there, though, which is something.
Some days closer, some further. Today, closer.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.resume.off: The first step. Nobody breaks it down like that. ...Alright, here it is.
You'd help with the small dull part? That's the part that never gets done.
Right. One step. I can manage one step with company, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.resume.dou: ...Still, yes. That's rather how wanting something works.
You asked me about it once. I thought you cared.
Aye. Still on about it. I'll keep it to myself in future.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.resume.lea: I will. Thank you for remembering it at all.
Right. Back to the possible things.
dialogue.conversations.topic.hopes.respo: It's a small thing to want. I want it anyway.
That thing I was hoping for.
dialogue.conversations.topic.hopes.respo: That's a bit much to hope for.
dialogue.conversations.topic.hopes.follo: What would the first step be?
I hope for something like that too.
Is that really what you want?
dialogue.conversations.hopes.respond.lis: ...Right. Then here's the rest of it, since you're actually waiting.
You'll wait for it. Most people fill the gap with advice.
Listening's rarer than helping, and worth more some days.
dialogue.conversations.hopes.respond.enc: So do I. It helps, hearing someone else say it.
Thank you. It's a small hope. Small ones still bruise.
From your mouth to whoever's listening, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.hopes.respond.moc: ...It's a small thing, %1$s. That's what makes it sting.
Too much. Right. I'll keep the next one to myself.
Everyone's hoping for something. Mine's no bigger than yours.
dialogue.conversations.hopes.respond.lea: Off you go. It'll still be here.
dialogue.conversations.hopes.followup.as: ...I've never got that far. Break it down, you say. Alright: first the wall, then the roof.
The first step. Huh. That makes it a plan instead of a wish.
Give me a day on that one. It's a better question than I'm ready for.
dialogue.conversations.hopes.followup.sh: Do you? Then we're both waiting on something. Good company.
Tell me yours. I've shown mine, %1$s.
It's easier to hope in twos. I've always thought so.
dialogue.conversations.hopes.followup.qu: ...Is it. That's a fair question and I've been avoiding it.
Straight to the bone. Good. Let me actually think about that.
Hm. It might be the wrong hope, at that. ...You get one back: what's yours?
...Yes. It is. Why would I say it otherwise?
That's a cold way to take something I just handed you, %1$s.
Now I'm doubting it, which I expect was the effect.
Most days, yes. Some days I'm less sure.
It's what I've got. Whether it's what I want is another matter.
Fair to ask. I'll not pretend I'm certain.
dialogue.conversations.hopes.resume.stil: You remembered the shape of it, not just that there was one. Yes. Still.
We worked out the first step, you and I. I've taken it. Once.
Still hoping — and now it has a shape, which helps more than you'd think.
Still. It hasn't moved, but neither have I stopped.
Aye. Hoping's cheap. Doing is the expensive part.
Some days. Today, since you asked, yes.
dialogue.conversations.hopes.resume.offe: ...You'd actually help. That changes it from a hope to a job of work.
Help. Right. Then it might actually happen, %1$s.
Nobody offers with hopes. They only offer with problems.
dialogue.conversations.hopes.resume.dism: ...Still on that. Yes. It's a hope, not a mood.
You asked me about it, %1$s. I answered honestly.
dialogue.conversations.hopes.resume.leav: So do I. Thank you for remembering, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.topic.regrets.res: That's the one that stays with me.
dialogue.conversations.topic.regrets.fol: So there it is. Said out loud.
dialogue.conversations.arc.regrets.resum: That thing I told you I regret.
dialogue.conversations.topic.regrets.res: I'm not going anywhere. Go on.
Is there anything left to put right?
That's a lot to carry. I'll go.
dialogue.conversations.topic.regrets.fol: I don't think you're a bad person.
I won't tell you it was fine. But I'm here.
You could still make it right.
That's a lot to carry. I'll go.
dialogue.conversations.arc.regrets.resum: Has it sat any easier since?
Have you thought any more about putting it right?
So about that thing you did.
dialogue.conversations.regrets.respond.l: ...Alright. Nobody stays for this part. They remember an errand.
You'll stand there and hear it. That's the whole of what I wanted.
Then I'll say the rest, and you can decide what you think of me after.
dialogue.conversations.regrets.respond.a: ...Maybe. I've not let myself look at that question properly.
Put right. Huh. Everyone else asks what happened, not what's left.
There might be. It'd take more courage than I've had lately.
dialogue.conversations.regrets.respond.p: Exactly what I did is mine. That I regret it is what I gave you.
You want the detail more than the person. I've noticed that before.
dialogue.conversations.regrets.respond.l: Aye. Thank you for not making a face about it.
Go on, %1$s. It'll still be mine tomorrow.
Right. Enough of that for one day.
...You don't. Nobody's said that. I'm not sure I believe it, but I'll keep it.
That's a generous reading of me, %1$s. I'll try to earn it.
Careful. Say that and I might start believing it.
...That's better. Absolution I'd not have trusted. This I do.
You didn't tidy it up for me. Thank you for that.
Not fine, and not alone either. I can live with that, %1$s.
...I could. You're right, and I've been telling myself otherwise.
Blunt. Correct. That's the pair of things I needed.
Still time, you reckon. Alright. I'll think on it properly.
...You've no idea what it would cost, %1$s.
Make it right. As though I hadn't thought of that every night since.
That's a lot to say to someone who just told you the worst of themselves.
Maybe. Maybe it's too late for that particular door.
You might be right. I'd want to be sure before I tried.
Perhaps. I'll not decide it standing here.
dialogue.conversations.regrets.resume.as: It has, a little. You told me I wasn't a bad person and it stuck.
Easier, aye. Somebody deciding I was worth forgiving did that.
Since you said what you said — yes. Odd how much a sentence weighs.
A little. You didn't tell me it was fine, and that's why I believed the rest.
Easier. Not lighter — easier. There's a difference and you knew it.
You sat with it instead of fixing it. That's what let it settle.
dialogue.conversations.regrets.resume.en: ...I have, since you asked last. Thinking's most of the way there.
You're going to keep asking, aren't you. Good. I need someone to.
A little. It's closer to a plan than it was, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.regrets.resume.br: ...You said you'd not use it against me.
That was told to you, %1$s. Not handed over.
I regret telling you more than I regret the thing, just now.
dialogue.conversations.regrets.resume.le: Aye. Best left where it is.
Thank you, %1$s. For coming back and for stopping.
dialogue.conversations.topic.secret.foll: So now you're carrying it too.
dialogue.conversations.arc.secret.resume: That thing I trusted you with.
dialogue.conversations.topic.secret.resp: Don't tell me something you'll regret.
dialogue.conversations.topic.secret.foll: It stays with me. You have my word.
I won't promise. But I'll try.
dialogue.conversations.arc.secret.resume: I've been thinking of letting it slip.
dialogue.conversations.secret.respond.ac: ...Alright. The 'famous' pie I bring to every festival? The trader sells it to me. Every year. I've been thanked for it eleven times.
You said that without hesitating. That's why it's you. ...I have never once liked the mayor's speeches. I clap because the baker watches.
Right. Once it's out it's out. ...There's a loose brick behind the well. My rainy-day emeralds live under it. Now two of us know where.
dialogue.conversations.secret.respond.as: Because you've never repeated a thing I've said. I've been counting. ...So: the festival pie. I buy it from the trader. I have never baked one in my life.
Because you asked why instead of leaning in. That's the answer, %1$s. ...And the answer to the other question is that I clap at the mayor to keep the baker happy.
Because there's nobody else. Less flattering, but honest. ...Loose brick, behind the well. Everything I've saved is under it. That's the thing.
dialogue.conversations.secret.respond.de: ...That's a kind thing to say to someone about to make a mistake. Right. It stays in, then.
You'd turn it down to protect me from myself. Noted, %1$s. ...It keeps. It's kept this long.
Mm. Perhaps you're right. It's waited years; it can wait a while longer.
dialogue.conversations.secret.respond.le: Off you go. I'll not hold it against you.
dialogue.conversations.topic.secret.decl: Right. It stays where it is, then.
Tell me when you're ready. I'll be about.
Come on - talk to me about something easier.
dialogue.conversations.secret.declined.o: ...When I'm ready. That's a door left open, not a hand pulling at it. I'll remember which you chose.
You'll be about. Aye. That's worth more to me than the telling would have been, %1$s.
Then I'll know where to find you when it gets too big to hold. That's a comfort, oddly.
dialogue.conversations.secret.declined.c: Gladly. Ask me about the fence, the weather, anything with no weight to it.
Something easier. Aye, let's. My head's had enough of the hard thing for one day.
Right you are. Easier things it is, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.secret.declined.l: Off you go. It'll be here, unfortunately.
Go on. I'll get back to pretending there's nothing to say.
dialogue.conversations.secret.followup.p: ...Your word. Then I'll sleep tonight for the first time in a while.
I'm holding you to that, %1$s. It's the only thing I've asked of you.
Good. Then it's two of us and no more, ever.
dialogue.conversations.secret.followup.n: ...You won't promise. That's more honest than a promise, in truth.
Trying is what people actually do. Promising is what they say.
I'd rather have your 'I'll try' than someone else's oath, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.secret.followup.t: I've carried that for eleven years, %1$s, and you weighed it in a breath.
Forget I said it. Truly — forget it.
dialogue.conversations.secret.resume.ref: You gave your word and you've kept it. I checked, in my way. Thank you.
Nobody's looked at me strangely since. That's how I know, %1$s.
A promise kept. It's rarer than you'd think, and I noticed.
You wouldn't promise, and you've kept it anyway. That says more.
No oath from you. And still not a word out. I think about that.
You only said you'd try. You tried, %1$s. That'll do.
It's still between us, then. Good.
Nobody's mentioned it. I take that as an answer.
Still ours. That's all I wanted to know.
dialogue.conversations.secret.resume.che: ...You asked after ME, not the secret. Nobody does that.
Lighter, since somebody else knows. That's the whole use of telling.
Some days it's heavy. Today, less so, because you asked.
dialogue.conversations.secret.resume.ask: Nobody. You're the whole list, %1$s. That's why I check the door when I say it.
Not a soul. I've had chances - I've had drink and company and chances - and no.
Just you. Which means if it ever gets out, I'll know exactly where to look. ...That's not a threat. It's just arithmetic.
dialogue.conversations.secret.resume.hin: ...Say that again and I'll know exactly what you are.
You're joking. Tell me you're joking, %1$s.
That is the one thing. The ONE thing I asked.
dialogue.conversations.secret.resume.lea: Aye. Thank you for saying so out loud.
Off you go, %1$s. And thank you.
Right you are. It's safe. I know.
dialogue.conversations.regrets.revisit: That thing I told you about. It's still there, mostly.
dialogue.conversations.regrets.revisit/1: I've been turning it over since we spoke. Not to much effect.
dialogue.conversations.regrets.revisit/2: You know the one. I don't need to name it twice.
dialogue.conversations.life.close.thank: Thank me for what - for being old? ...No, I know what you mean. You're welcome, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.life.close.thank/: It's only what happened. But aye - not everyone gets told, so take the thanks back.
Hm. It's a strange thing to be thanked for a life. I'll take it, mind.
dialogue.conversations.life.close.say_me: ...It did. You don't lay the whole thing out for just anybody.
Telling it in order is the hard part. You keep wanting to defend the middle bits.
You noticed that. It's easy to hear a life and think it's only talking, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.life.close.leave: Aye. Go on, and thank you.
dialogue.conversations.life.close.leave/: Right. Enough of that for one day.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.close.than: Don't thank me yet. Thank me if it ever turns into anything.
You're welcome. Saying it to someone makes it feel a bit more like a plan, %1$s.
Aye, well. It cost me nothing to say and rather a lot to admit. Both of those are true.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.close.say_: ...It did. Wanting a thing out loud is how people find out you might fail at it.
Saying it makes it real enough to be disappointed by. That's the cost of it.
You noticed that. Everyone thinks a dream is the easy thing to talk about, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.close.leav: Aye. Go on, and thank you.
Right. Enough of that for one day.
dialogue.conversations.hopes.close.thank: Thank you for not laughing, more like. That's the harder half.
You're welcome, %1$s. Now forget I said it, in case saying it spoils it.
Aye. It's an embarrassing thing, hoping out loud. You made it less so.
dialogue.conversations.hopes.close.say_m: ...It did. Hoping where somebody can hear you is a small act of daftness.
It's the being-seen-hoping that's hard. Not the hoping.
You noticed that. It's the softest thing I own, %1$s, and I just left it out on the table.
dialogue.conversations.hopes.close.leave: Aye. Go on, and thank you.
Right. Enough of that for one day.
dialogue.conversations.regrets.close.tha: Thanking me for that is an odd thing to do. ...But I'd rather odd than nothing.
You're welcome. It's the first time I've said it and not felt worse after, %1$s.
Hm. Thank you for hearing it without arranging your face.
dialogue.conversations.regrets.close.say: ...It did. Saying it out loud stops you pretending it was smaller than it was.
Every telling I've rehearsed came out kinder to me than that one did.
You noticed that. I've spent years arranging that story so it wasn't my fault, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.regrets.close.lea: Aye. Go on, and thank you.
Right. Enough of that for one day.
dialogue.conversations.secret.close.than: You don't have to thank me for it. ...But thank you for the thanking.
It's not a gift, %1$s. Still — aye. You're welcome.
Strange thing to be thanked for. I'll take it.
dialogue.conversations.secret.close.say_: ...It did. More than I'd admit standing here.
Saying it out loud was the hard part. You made it easier.
dialogue.conversations.secret.close.leav: Aye. Go on, and thank you.
Right. Enough of that for one day.
dialogue.conversations.secret.resume.che: ...You asked after me, not the secret. You always were the right person to tell.
Lighter, since you know. That's the whole use of having told someone, %1$s.
Better. Knowing one person carries it with me changes the weight of it.
dialogue.conversations.topic.feelings.ro: That's how I feel about you.
So now you know where I stand.
dialogue.conversations.topic.feelings.pl: That's what you are to me.
dialogue.conversations.topic.feelings.yo: That's what I think of you.
dialogue.conversations.arc.feelings.resu: About what I said to you.
dialogue.conversations.topic.feelings.ro: I feel the same about you.
What do you need from me?
There's something we should talk about.
I need us to go slower.
Let's not make this a whole thing.
dialogue.conversations.topic.feelings.pl: And how do you feel about me?
You're a friend. A real one.
I'm fond of you, and that's all.
Don't read too much into it.
dialogue.conversations.topic.feelings.yo: You're a good sort, you know.
dialogue.conversations.feelings.romantic: ...Say that again. I've waited a long while to hear it back.
The same. You're sure? ...Good. Good.
Then we've both been carrying it. Idiots, the pair of us.
What I need. Nobody's ever asked it that way round.
...Time, mostly. And for you to keep asking that question.
Less than you'd think, and more than I say. Ask me again sometimes.
...Alright. I'd rather hear it than have you carry it quietly.
Say it, then. We've never been the sort to leave things unsaid.
That tone. Right — go on, I'm listening properly.
Aye. Some things want a moment afterwards.
Go on. I'll be here, %1$s.
Right. That's enough honesty for one afternoon.
...Plainly. After all this time you say it plainly. I love you too.
You don't say things you don't mean. That's how I know.
Then say it every so often, %1$s. I'll not tire of it.
...Slower. Alright. I'd rather have you at your pace than not at all.
Thank you for saying it instead of just going quiet on me.
Slower it is. You've not changed your mind about me, though?
...A whole thing. Right. Forget I brought it up.
It was a whole thing to me, %1$s.
Mm. I'll keep it smaller next time.
dialogue.conversations.feelings.platonic: ...Do I? People don't say that out loud round here.
That's a good thing to be told on an ordinary day.
You matter to me too, %1$s. There — we've both said it.
Fondly. Straightforwardly. You're one of the good ones.
Like someone I'd notice if they stopped coming by.
Warmly, and without complication. That's rarer than it sounds.
Fair enough. Not everything needs a speech.
Aye, let's not. It stands whether we say it or not.
Suits me, %1$s. I'd only get awkward.
...A real one. That's a word people use loosely. Not you, I think.
Friend. Aye. I'll take that and keep it.
Then that's what we are. Good. That's settled.
And that's plenty. Honestly, %1$s, that's plenty.
Fond, and no more. Good — I'd rather know the shape of it.
Clear is kind. Thank you for being clear.
...I wasn't. You brought it up, %1$s.
Read too much into it. Right. I'll read nothing into anything.
Noted. I'll keep my regard to myself.
dialogue.conversations.feelings.close.th: You don't have to thank me. ...But you're welcome.
Saying it was the hard part, %1$s.
Aye. Well. Now we both know.
dialogue.conversations.feelings.close.sa: No. But I'd have regretted the silence more, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.feelings.young.ki: ...Am I? Nobody says that to me.
dialogue.conversations.feelings.young.pr: Glad you're around. Ha. Don't get soppy about it. ...That was nice, though.
Me too. About you being around, I mean.
...Thank you. Most people take a 'not yet' badly.
Good. These things want their own time.
Now that I can answer. Ask away.
Something easier. Aye — we'll build up.
I could. I'd rather not, and that should be enough.
Pressing on that won't make it true sooner, %1$s.
No. Ask me when we've more behind us.
dialogue.conversations.feelings.again.ap: It's alright. It's not a thing that changes hourly.
