dialogue.conversations.feelings.again.pr: The same as an hour ago, and just as hard to say.
dialogue.conversations.feelings.revisit: I've been thinking about what I said to you. I meant it, in case you wondered.
dialogue.conversations.feelings.revisit/: That conversation we had. It's been sitting with me, in a good way.
You'll remember what I told you. I've not changed my mind, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.feelings.resume.c: Changed? No. If anything it's settled into something steadier.
Not changed. Asked after, though — that's new, and I like it.
It has, a little. For the better, since you're asking.
dialogue.conversations.feelings.resume.r: ...You meant it. People say things once and hope you forget.
Said twice. That's how I know it was true the first time.
dialogue.conversations.feelings.resume.l: Aye. Let it be, for now.
dialogue.conversations.topic.us.close: Anyway. We're alright, you and I.
dialogue.conversations.topic.happy.respo: That's how we are, I think.
dialogue.conversations.topic.future.foll: So what do we do about it?
dialogue.conversations.topic.worries.fol: So there it is, said out loud.
That's what I wanted to know.
dialogue.conversations.topic.memories.re: That's the one I always come back to.
dialogue.conversations.topic.firstmet.re: You were a state, as I recall.
dialogue.conversations.topic.firstmet.fo: It was a long time ago.
dialogue.conversations.topic.future.resp: Let's not plan that far ahead.
dialogue.conversations.topic.future.foll: We want different things. Let's work it out.
I won't promise what I can't give.
dialogue.conversations.topic.worries.res: Tell me the rest of it.
dialogue.conversations.topic.worries.fol: You don't have to solve it today.
dialogue.conversations.topic.checkin_chi: Tell me how they really are.
You don't need to worry about me.
dialogue.conversations.topic.memories.fo: Are you sure about that bit?
dialogue.conversations.us.happy.listen: ...Honestly, then. Mostly yes. There's a thing, but mostly yes.
dialogue.conversations.us.happy.listen/1: You want the true answer, not the easy one. Alright.
dialogue.conversations.us.happy.listen/2: Nobody asks and waits. You waited. So — here it is.
dialogue.conversations.us.happy.affirm: Are you? Good. Say that more often, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.us.happy.affirm/1: So am I. It's easy to forget to say it.
dialogue.conversations.us.happy.affirm/2: Then we're both alright. That's not nothing, after this long.
dialogue.conversations.us.happy.defensiv: ...It wasn't an accusation. It was a question.
That's exactly the tone I was worried about, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.us.happy.ask_impr: ...You want to know. Right. Small things — and you asking is one of them fixed.
Nobody asks that. Give me a day and I'll have a real answer.
Better. Aye — there is a better. Thank you for wanting it.
dialogue.conversations.us.happy.reassure: We will. I believe you when you say it.
Aye. We've been through worse than this week.
That helps more than solving it would, honestly.
dialogue.conversations.us.happy.dismiss/: Worry too much. Right. That's me told.
Then I'll worry quietly and not bother you with it.
dialogue.conversations.us.firstmet.share: You remember it differently to me. I love that.
Go on then — I want to hear your version.
Ha! That's not how I tell it at all.
dialogue.conversations.us.firstmet.tease: I WAS a state. You were no better, %1$s.
Ha! Say that again and I'll tell everyone what YOU said.
dialogue.conversations.us.firstmet.brush: I've thought about that day more than I'd admit, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.us.firstmet.ask_s: ...You did. Not anything you said. Just that you stayed.
The way you spoke to the baker, actually. Kindness when nobody's counting.
I'll not tell you. You'll only get insufferable about it.
dialogue.conversations.us.firstmet.corre: ...Was it not? Huh. I've told it wrong for years, then.
You'd know better than me. You were the sober one.
Maybe. I like my version, mind.
dialogue.conversations.us.firstmet.dismi: It was. It's still the day I count from, %1$s.
Long ago, aye. Not gone, though.
dialogue.conversations.us.firstmet.leave: Aye. Nice to think back, though.
dialogue.conversations.us.future.align: You do? ...Then that's the whole conversation, and a good one.
dialogue.conversations.us.future.align/1: Same thing. After all my worrying, the same thing.
dialogue.conversations.us.future.align/2: Good. Then we plan instead of wondering.
dialogue.conversations.us.future.ask_pri: What matters most. ...You. Then the rest, in some order.
Nobody asks it that way round. Give me a moment to answer honestly.
A roof, quiet, and someone in it. That's the whole list.
dialogue.conversations.us.future.avoid: ...Not that far ahead. Alright. I'll stop bringing it up.
dialogue.conversations.us.future.avoid/1: We have to plan it sometime, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.us.future.avoid/2: Mm. I notice you always say that.
dialogue.conversations.us.future.negotia: ...Work it out. Aye. That's better than one of us just giving in.
Different things and still here. That's most of a marriage, %1$s.
Then we'll talk it through properly. Not tonight, but properly.
dialogue.conversations.us.future.promise: That's fair. I'd rather that than a promise you'd resent.
No promises. Good. We've both seen what those cost.
Honest. I'll take honest over comfortable.
dialogue.conversations.us.future.reject/: You could have said 'not yet'. You said never.
Then I'll stop hoping for it. Consider it stopped.
dialogue.conversations.us.future.leave: Aye. It's not a one-evening subject.
dialogue.conversations.us.future.leave/1: Go on. We'll come back to it, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.us.worries.valida: ...It is, isn't it. I'd half convinced myself it was silly.
You didn't tell me not to worry. Thank you for that.
Worth worrying about. Aye. That helps, oddly.
dialogue.conversations.us.worries.ask_de: The rest of it. Alright — but it gets less reasonable from here.
You want all of it. Nobody wants all of it, %1$s.
Right. Sit down. This is the long version.
dialogue.conversations.us.worries.dismis: ...Nothing to fret over. Right. I'll fret quietly, then.
Then I'll not mention the next one.
dialogue.conversations.us.worries.help_s: Together. ...That's the part I couldn't do alone. Alright.
You'd take half of it. Then take the half with the letter in it, that one's worst.
Right. Then it's a job, not a worry. That I can manage.
dialogue.conversations.us.worries.give_s: ...Not today. That's permission I didn't know I needed.
You're right. It'll still be there tomorrow and so will I.
Thank you. Everyone wants it solved by supper.
dialogue.conversations.us.worries.change: Aye, let's. I've turned it over enough for one evening.
Good idea. Tell me something ordinary, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.us.worries.leave: Aye. Thank you for asking at all.
dialogue.conversations.us.close.thank: You don't need to thank me for that.
dialogue.conversations.us.close.thank/1: Aye, well. That's what this is for, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.us.close.thank/2: Thank you for listening to it.
dialogue.conversations.us.close.say_mean: ...It did. More than I let on.
Good. I'd hate to have said it for nothing.
dialogue.conversations.family.child.list: ...Really are. Right. Not as well as I tell people, if I'm honest.
You want the true answer about them. That's kind of you to ask for.
Better than last month. Worse than I'd like. That's children.
dialogue.conversations.family.child.prai: ...Am I? Some days I'm certain I'm not.
That's the thing nobody says to a parent. Thank you, %1$s.
I try. It's good to be told the trying shows.
dialogue.conversations.family.child.dism: That's a thing said by someone without any, %1$s.
Right. I'll stop telling you about them, then.
dialogue.conversations.family.child.guid: ...That's useful. Actually useful, not the usual advice.
You've thought about this. Say it again, slower.
I'll try it. If it works I'll say it was my idea.
dialogue.conversations.family.child.play: They ARE. Don't tell them I agreed with you.
Wonderful and exhausting, in that order.
Ha! You'd change your mind by supper, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.family.child.scol: ...A firmer hand. That's not what they need.
Mm. I'll pretend you didn't say that.
dialogue.conversations.family.child.leav: Aye. They'll want feeding shortly anyway.
dialogue.conversations.family.parent.ans: ...Thank you. You've never fobbed me off, and I notice.
The truth. Right. That's all I was after.
Good. I'd rather a hard true thing than a soft false one.
dialogue.conversations.family.parent.rea: I'll worry anyway. That's the arrangement, %1$s.
...Alright. I'll try to worry less. No promises.
It helps to hear it. It doesn't stop it, but it helps.
dialogue.conversations.family.parent.sna: Fussing. Is that what it looks like from there?
dialogue.conversations.family.parent.ask: ...You want to know what I worry about? Nobody's asked me that.
Everything. Mostly you. That's the honest answer.
The usual things a person worries about, and one or two more.
dialogue.conversations.family.parent.tha: ...You're welcome. It's the only useful thing I do.
Thanked for asking. Well. That's new, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.family.parent.def: Mm. I'll ask again next week.
dialogue.conversations.family.memories.l: You'd forgotten! I've told that one at every feast for six years.
Ha! Then it's worth telling again.
Good. It's better when somebody's hearing it fresh.
dialogue.conversations.family.memories.a: More? Careful — I've a great many and no shame.
Right, there's the one about the goat. You'll regret asking.
You're the first to ask for a second one, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.family.memories.b: You weren't there for that one.
dialogue.conversations.family.memories.a: You've one I don't know? Go on — I'll not interrupt. Much.
Ha! Then we're trading, and I want the good one.
New to me. That's rare after all this time, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.family.memories.q: ...It might have been the other summer. Doesn't spoil it.
You're checking my facts. In MY story.
Sure enough. Sure-ish. Let me have it.
dialogue.conversations.family.memories.d: ...I do always tell that one. It's a good one.
Then I'll find a new one, %1$s.
Right. I'll spare you the rest.
dialogue.conversations.family.memories.l: Aye. Another time, and I'll have a better one.
dialogue.conversations.family.close.than: Family doesn't need thanking. But you're welcome.
Aye, well. That's what we're for, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.family.close.say_: ...It did. More than I'd say out loud.
Then it was worth the saying.
Good. We don't say enough, in this family.
dialogue.conversations.family.memories.t: There's one I always come back to. Sit down.
Family stories. I've a hundred and you'll hear at least one.
Ha — where do I start. The goat, probably.
dialogue.conversations.us.firstmet.tell: You want the story of how we met? Go on, then. I'll tell it my way.
dialogue.conversations.us.firstmet.tell/: The day we met. I remember more of it than I let on, %1$s.
Ha. That day. Right — my version first.
dialogue.conversations.feelings.platonic: Aye. Some things don't need dwelling on.
Off you go, %1$s.
Right. Good to have said it, though.
dialogue.conversations.us.happy.listen.a: We've talked about this before, you and I. It's better than it was. Mostly.
You keep coming back to ask. That's most of why it's better, %1$s.
Same question, and a different answer this time. That's progress.
dialogue.conversations.family.memories.l: We've built a stock of these, you and I. That's what a family is, in the end.
Another one for the pile. There'll be more, %1$s.
You've heard half of these twice and you still laugh. That counts for something.
dialogue.conversations.fears.open.rebuff: ...Aye. Well. I'm prickly about it, and you weren't to know. We'll call it even.
It did. But I've the shorter fuse where that's concerned. Let's leave it there, %1$s.
Mm. Thank you for not arguing the point. Most would have.
...That's the right answer, and I didn't expect it. Sit there a minute, if you like.
Good. Not everything wants handling. Some of it just wants somebody stood nearby.
Right. You listen well when you stop trying to help, %1$s. That's not an insult.
Aye. Go on. I'll be less of a hedgehog tomorrow.
Off you go. It's not you I'm cross with, for what it's worth.
Right you are, %1$s. Mind the step.
dialogue.conversations.topic.fears.repai: Alright. We'll try this again, slower.
Ask me something I can answer easily.
You set the pace. I'll keep to it.
dialogue.conversations.fears.repaired.as: Now that I can do. Ask me about the fence, the harvest, anything with a floor to stand on.
Something easy. Aye. We'll build back up to the rest, in our own time.
Sensible, %1$s. Shallow water first. I'll tell you when I can swim again.
dialogue.conversations.fears.repaired.re: ...Then we'll get there. Slowly, and without anyone's hand on my back.
You'll keep to it. I believe you, which is the strange part.
That's all I ever wanted asked of me, %1$s. Just that.
dialogue.conversations.fears.repaired.le: Aye. Enough digging for one day. Come back and I'll still be here.
Right. Off you go, and thank you for the slower version.
Go on, %1$s. We're alright, you and I.
There. That's the whole of it, and I've never said it out loud.
How long have you had that?
dialogue.conversations.fears.open.disclo: ...You say that like it's a sack of grain. Like it's a thing that divides up. Alright. Take a corner of it, then.
It doesn't work like that. ...Except it does, apparently, because it's lighter and you've done nothing but stand there, %1$s.
Then it isn't mine alone any more. I don't know what to do with that. Something good, I expect.
Longer than I've lived in this house. It came with me, like a piece of furniture I keep meaning to leave behind.
Since I was small enough to fit under a table. I remember the table better than the reason.
Long enough that I'd stopped thinking of it as a thing that started. It's just weather, to me.
Aye. That's plenty. ...Thank you for hearing the whole of it, %1$s.
Enough. Go on. I've said more today than in the last year of days.
Right. Off with you, before I say a third thing I can't take back.
dialogue.conversations.fears.followthrou: There wasn't a promise, %1$s. You've just kept turning up, which I've decided counts for more.
I don't recall you swearing to anything. You've simply been about. That's its own sort of word.
No oath between us. Only the asking, over and over. I'd not trade that for an oath.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.resume.ask: You never told me it would work. You came back to ask anyway. That's why I'm still at it.
Somebody who said the hard thing and still wants to know how it's going - aye, a little closer.
You promised me nothing, %1$s. It makes the asking mean more, not less.
dialogue.conversations.regrets.resume.as: A little. Time does some of it. Being asked after does the rest.
Some days. It's the sort of thing that goes quiet rather than goes away.
Easier than it was, %1$s. I'd not have noticed if you hadn't asked.
dialogue.conversations.fears.followthrou: You did say that. ...It's been a while since, mind. I'd started filling in the blank myself.
I remember the promise, %1$s. I remember the days after it, too, and you weren't in many of them.
Aye, you said it. People do say it. I'd stopped counting on it, is all.
dialogue.conversations.topic.fears.lapse: You did say it. That's not nothing.
Then let me be there now.
dialogue.conversations.fears.lapsed.apol: ...Well. That's more than most would say. It's not undone, but it's said, and that helps.
You could have argued. You didn't. ...Alright, %1$s. We're not square, but we're speaking.
Mm. Owning it costs something. I noticed you paid it.
dialogue.conversations.fears.lapsed.make: Now, you mean. ...Right. Now will do. Now is the only bit anyone can actually offer.
Then be here, and we'll say no more about the gap, %1$s.
Alright. Second time of asking. I'd not give everyone that.
dialogue.conversations.fears.lapsed.leav: No excuses. Aye - that's the right call, and I'd have thought less of a good one.
Off you go, then. It's not the end of anything, %1$s. It's just a thing that happened.
Right. We'll leave it where it is and see what you do next.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.resume.ask: You said you'd help. I waited a bit, then got on with it alone. That's usually how it goes.
Some. On my own, mostly - you'd offered, and then the days went by, %1$s.
It's moved. Not because of the offer, if I'm honest. But you're asking now, and that's something.
dialogue.conversations.topic.food.toddle: Which one is the best one?
Off you go and eat, then.
dialogue.conversations.food.toddler.deli: It IS! It's the best one. I said so and I was RIGHT.
You know about good food! Grown-ups don't usually.
Excellent food. That's what it is. Excellent.
dialogue.conversations.food.toddler.ask: The best one is... all of them. But mostly the first one.
dialogue.conversations.food.toddler.ask/: The one you get when you've been good. That one tastes different.
Whichever is biggest. Bigger food tastes better, everyone knows.
dialogue.conversations.food.toddler.leav: Okay bye! I'm going to eat now. All of it.
dialogue.conversations.topic.life.toddle: That's my whole life so far.
That sounds like a very good life.
What's the best part of a day?
dialogue.conversations.life.toddler.deli: It IS good! I'm having the best one. I checked.
You think so too! Then it's true, 'cause you're big.
A GOOD life. Yes. That's what I've got.
dialogue.conversations.life.toddler.ask: The middle bit. That's when everything happens.
dialogue.conversations.life.toddler.ask/: When it's not too early and not bedtime. The in-between part.
The part with the snack in it. Obviously the part with the snack.
dialogue.conversations.life.toddler.leav: Bye! I've got a lot to do today.
Bye bye. I'll be here. I'm always here.
dialogue.conversations.topic.dreams.todd: That's what I'm going to be.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.toddler.de: You BELIEVE me. Nobody says that, they just laugh and go 'aww'.
Then it's happening. It's decided. You said it and now it's decided.
I KNOW. I'm going to be it so much, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.toddler.as: You just do it. You do it and then it's done. That's how.
Eating. Eating makes you get big and then you can do anything.
Practising. Every day. Except some days 'cause of naps.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.toddler.le: Bye! I'm going to go practise being it.
Bye bye. You'll see. You'll ALL see.
dialogue.conversations.topic.hopes.toddl: What else are you hoping for?
Off you go and hope, then.
dialogue.conversations.hopes.toddler.del: You hope too! Then it's TWO hopes. Two is stronger.
Good. Everyone should hope for it. Then it has to happen.
Yes! Hope with me, %1$s. Hard as you can.
dialogue.conversations.hopes.toddler.ask: Um. A hat. And for tomorrow to come faster.
That the loud thing outside stops being loud. And a pocket.
Lots of stuff. I keep them in my head. There's LOADS.
dialogue.conversations.hopes.toddler.lea: Bye! I'm going to go and hope somewhere else.
dialogue.conversations.topic.feelings.to: Those are good feelings to have.
Off you go and feel it, then.
They ARE good ones. I've got the good ones today.
You're allowed lots at once. I checked. Nobody stopped me.
Good ones. Yep. Good ones all the way down, %1$s.
Like when you run down a hill but you're standing still.
Like bread. But inside. That's the closest one.
Um. Wiggly? It's a wiggly one. I don't know the word yet.
Bye! I'm going to go and feel it over there.
dialogue.conversations.topic.village.tod: What's your favourite bit of it?
dialogue.conversations.village.toddler.d: It's the BEST village. There isn't a better one anywhere.
You like it too! Then you should live here. Everyone should.
dialogue.conversations.village.toddler.a: The bit with the water in. But I'm not allowed close.
Behind the houses. There's a gap and it's MINE.
The high bit! You can see everything from the high bit.
dialogue.conversations.village.toddler.l: Bye! I'm going to go and be in it.
Bye bye. Don't get lost, it's big.
dialogue.conversations.topic.checkin.tod: That is a very good report.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.toddler.d: It IS a good report. I did a good one.
A REPORT. Like a proper one. I'm going to tell Mama I did a report.
Good report! Thank you, %1$s. I'll do another one tomorrow.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.toddler.a: The best bit was the bit at the start. Before everything else.
There were LOTS of best bits. That's why it's a good day.
The bit nobody saw. That one's mine. ...Okay, I'll tell you later.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.toddler.l: Bye bye. Ask me again tomorrow, there'll be more.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.young.marr: %2$s and %3$s got MARRIED. There was cake. I had two bits.
%2$s married %3$s! Everyone was crying but the happy kind, which is confusing.
Did you know about %2$s and %3$s? Married. I threw the petals.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.young.deat: %2$s died. Everyone's being quiet about it and I don't like the quiet.
We're not supposed to talk about %2$s. But you asked, so.
%2$s isn't here any more. Not gone-away. The other one.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.young.divo: %2$s and %3$s don't live together now. Nobody will say why when I'm in the room.
%2$s moved out from %3$s. I asked why and got given a biscuit instead of an answer.
Something happened with %2$s and %3$s. Grown-ups stop talking when I come in.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.young.birt: There's a NEW BABY. It's called %2$s and it's very small and very loud.
%2$s got born! I'm not allowed to hold it yet. I asked eleven times.
A baby came. %2$s. It doesn't do anything yet but everyone stares at it.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.young.arri: %2$s is new. I've been watching them to see what they're like.
Someone moved in! %2$s. They don't know where anything is yet, so I helped.
There's a new person, %2$s. New people are the best thing that happens here.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.young.depa: %2$s went away. Their house is empty and I keep looking at it.
%2$s left. Just left. I didn't get to say the goodbye properly.
%2$s doesn't live here now. I don't know where they went. Nobody does.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.young.ques: Somebody helped %2$s with a thing! A big thing. I heard it from two people.
%2$s got their problem sorted. I don't know what the problem was but it's sorted.
%2$s owes somebody a favour now. That's what my mother said, anyway.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.young.none: Nothing happened. NOTHING. It's been the most boring week of my whole life.
No news. I've been checking every day, too.
Nothing! Not one thing! Come back when something happens, %1$s.
Thank you for telling me properly.
How did you find that out?
dialogue.conversations.news.young.take_s: ...Properly. You said properly. Grown-ups usually do the voice where they don't believe me.
You're the first one who didn't check with somebody taller first, %1$s.
I TOLD it properly. I practised. Thank you for noticing that I practised.
dialogue.conversations.news.young.ask_ho: I listen. Nobody thinks I'm listening because I'm playing, but I'm always listening.
People say things over my head like I'm furniture. So I know nearly everything.
I was under the table. That's the best place, %1$s. You should try it.
dialogue.conversations.news.young.dismis: ...It's not repeating if it's TRUE. You asked me. You asked and now I'm in trouble for answering.
Everyone else repeats things. I've heard them. But when I do it it's different, apparently.
Fine. Then I won't tell you the next one.
dialogue.conversations.news.young.leave: Okay bye! I'll come and find you if something else happens.
dialogue.conversations.news.young.leave/: Bye, %1$s! There'll be more tomorrow, there always is.
Right. I'm going to go and find out more things.
dialogue.conversations.arc.dreams.resume: So that's where it's got to.
Keep at it. You'll get there.
It might not happen, you know.
I'll let you get on with it.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.resume.fol: You say that like it's obvious. It isn't, but I'll borrow your version for a bit.
Aye. Well. It's easier to keep at a thing when somebody's watching to see if you do.
I'll get there. ...I said that out loud and it didn't sound stupid, %1$s. That's new.
The next step. Nobody asks that. They ask if I'm still doing it, which isn't the same question.
Right - the next step is the boring one. Which is why it's still the next one.
Give me a moment. ...There. Written on the inside of my head. Thank you for making me say it.
It might not. I know. I'd rather hear that from you than from myself at three in the morning.
That's the truth of it, aye. Doesn't stop me. But it's good that one of us says it.
Not many will say that. They nod and move on. ...I'd rather be told, %1$s.
Aye, go on. It'll still be here in the morning, worse luck.
Right you are. Back to it, then.
Off you go, %1$s. Thanks for asking after it.
dialogue.conversations.arc.fears.followt: You've come a long way with it.
You don't have to be finished.
I'll not make a thing of it.
dialogue.conversations.fears.followthrou: A long way. ...I hadn't measured it from the start. I'd only been measuring from here to the end.
Have I? Turn round and look back, you said. I never do that. It's further than I thought.
That's a kind way to put it, %1$s. And an accurate one, which is rarer.
The next hard bit is the one where nobody's watching. Those are always the worst ones.
Doing it twice. Once was luck. Twice is a person changing, and that's heavier.
Telling someone else. ...Not yet. You were the practice run, and you don't know how hard that was.
Not finished. ...I'd been treating it like a job with an end to it. It isn't, is it.
That takes the hurry out of it. I didn't know the hurry was most of the weight.
No deadline. Right. I'll breathe out, then, %1$s.
Aye. No fuss. That's how I'd want it.
Right you are. Off you go.
Go on, %1$s. And thank you for the asking.
dialogue.conversations.arc.fears.plan.fo: Then I'll be there for that bit.
I can't promise. But I'll try.
dialogue.conversations.fears.plan.follow: You'll be there. Then it's a plan and not a wish, which is the whole difference.
Right. Then I can't quietly not do it, can I. That's the useful part of telling someone.
Good. I'll hold you to it, %1$s, and you hold me to mine.
Easier. ...If it were smaller. If it were one step instead of the whole staircase.
Daylight would help. Everything's twice the size after dark, I've noticed.
Somebody standing where I can see them. That's all. That's the entire list, %1$s.
You can't promise. Good. I've had promises. I'd rather have somebody who counts the cost first.
'I'll try' is a real thing. 'I promise' is usually a way of ending a conversation.
That'll do. That'll do very well, in fact.
Aye. It's waited this long, it can wait for a good day.
Off you go, %1$s. I'll keep thinking on it.
dialogue.conversations.arc.feelings.resu: So that's where I am with it.
Is there more of it than that?
I should be honest about where I am.
dialogue.conversations.feelings.resume.f: You're glad. ...I'd spent a week deciding whether telling you would cost me something.
Then it was worth the saying. I wasn't sure it would be, %1$s.
Good. That's a weight off, and I'd been carrying it about like a bucket.
There's more. There's always more. But that's the part with words on it.
Some. The rest hasn't got a shape yet - ask me in a season and it might.
You're the only one who's asked the follow-up question, %1$s. Most stop at the first answer.
...Thank you for saying it straight. I'd rather know the shape of the ground I'm standing on.
That's fair. It stings a little, and it's fair, and I'd have it no other way.
Honest is better. It's not what I hoped, but it's better, %1$s.
Aye. Let it sit. Things settle better when nobody stirs them.
Right. We'll leave it where it is.
That's the state of the hoping.
I'm hoping for it too, now.
dialogue.conversations.hopes.resume.foll: You too, now. That's twice the hoping and none of the extra work. I'll take that trade.
Then if it doesn't come, at least two of us will be disappointed. That's oddly comforting.
Careful, %1$s - hoping alongside somebody is how you end up helping.
Move it along. Right. Less hoping and more Tuesday, is what you're saying.
A dry spell and a spare afternoon. That's genuinely all of it.
You'd turn a hope into a list. ...Go on, then. Let's make the list.
I know. I've been careful not to build the house before the ground's dry.
That's the sensible thing to say and I don't like you for saying it. ...You're right, though.
Everything on one hope. Aye. I've done that before, %1$s, and I remember the landing.
So do I. Thank you for hoping in my direction.
Off you go, %1$s. Fingers crossed and all that.
dialogue.conversations.arc.life.resume.f: I'm glad I know that now.
That explains a lot about you.
Was there more you left out?
dialogue.conversations.life.resume.follo: Glad. Hm. I'd braced for 'that's a lot' and got 'glad' instead.
Then it did what I hoped it would, which is rare for anything I say out loud.
Aye. Well. Now you know where the dents came from, %1$s.
...It does, doesn't it. Huh. I've never had those two things stood next to each other before.
You've gone and made sense of me. I'm not sure I wanted to be made sense of, but here we are.
It explains the good bits too, mind. Don't only use it for the awkward ones, %1$s.
There's always more left out. That's what leaving out means. ...Let it lie.
You get what I hand you. The rest isn't a locked door, it's just not a door at all.
Asking for the offcuts, %1$s. I gave you the whole loaf and you're after the crumbs.
Aye. Enough history for one afternoon.
Off you go, %1$s. Thanks for sitting through it.
dialogue.conversations.arc.regrets.resum: What would putting it right look like?
dialogue.conversations.regrets.resume.fo: Enough. Who decides that, though? ...You, apparently. Alright. I'll try it your way.
I've been paying by instalments for years. Somebody calling it settled is a strange feeling.
That's not yours to say, %1$s. ...Say it again anyway.
What it'd look like. Aye - that's the question I've been walking around for a long while.
Knocking on a door, mostly. It's a very short list and a very heavy one.
Saying it to the right person instead of to you. ...No offence meant. You've been good practice.
No. It isn't. Plenty take the forgiving job just to end the conversation - you didn't.
That's honest, and it leaves the thing where it belongs. I respect it and I don't enjoy it.
You're right, %1$s. It's theirs. I'd been hoping you'd hand it over cheap.
Aye. Leave it be. It's good at waiting.
Right you are. Off you go.
Go on, %1$s. Thank you for not making a meal of it.
dialogue.conversations.arc.secret.resume: That's the shape of it now.
What happens if it does get out?
dialogue.conversations.secret.resume.fol: I know. I check anyway - not on you, on the world. It's a habit, not a doubt.
Says the only person who could break it. ...And hasn't. That's the whole of my evidence, %1$s.
Safe. Right. I'll put that sentence somewhere I can get at it on the bad nights.
Lighter than it was. Heavy things don't stop being heavy; they just get better handles.
Some weeks. Not this one. You asking is part of why not this one, %1$s.
It is. But it's a shared heavy now, and that's a completely different weight.
If it gets out... I'd know it wasn't you, first. Then I'd survive it. I've worked that far.
I'd deny it once, badly, and then I'd stop denying it. That's as far as the plan goes.
Hm. ...It would be a bad week, and then it would be a Tuesday, I expect. Ask me something easier.
Aye. Off you go, and thank you for the checking.
Go on, %1$s. I sleep better for these little conversations.
...Don't. If you're kind about it now I'll not get through the rest of the day. ...But aye. Thank you. Say nothing else.
I'm allowed. I know I'm allowed. Knowing and feeling are two different counties, %1$s.
Right. Yes. Fine. ...You're the first who didn't tell me it gets easier, so - thank you for that.
Careful. Half the things I know, I know because nobody checked them either.
You want it verified? That's not how any of this works, %1$s. It's a market, not a ledger.
Ask for proof and people stop telling you things. That's a worse trade than being wrong sometimes.
dialogue.conversations.work_offer.ask_te: Now that's the right question, and you're the first today to ask it before saying yes.
Terms. Good. I'd have thought less of you for not asking, %1$s.
Straight to the price. I like that. It saves us both an afternoon of politeness.
dialogue.conversations.topic.life.follow: You've had a busier life than the mayor, then.
dialogue.conversations.life.followup.jok: Ha! I have, actually. He's had one long meeting since 1247 and I've had all of that.
The mayor. Don't. ...Although now you've said it I can't stop comparing, %1$s.
Busier and worse paid. Put that on the stone when I'm under it.
dialogue.conversations.topic.work.follow: So you're the reason it all still works.
dialogue.conversations.work.followup.jok: Ha. Don't tell the others. They think it holds itself up out of respect.
I am, and nobody will notice until the day I stop. That's the job, %1$s.
The reason, aye. Also the reason it breaks. Both true, sadly.
dialogue.conversations.topic.village.fol: It's held together with string and stubbornness.
Ha! String, stubbornness and one very determined blacksmith. That's the whole engineering of it.
Mostly stubbornness. The string is decorative, %1$s.
You've been paying attention. Don't say it near the mayor, he thinks it's masonry.
dialogue.conversations.topic.people.foll: You'd all be lost without somebody to complain about.
dialogue.conversations.people.followup.j: Ha! We would. Take away the complaining and there'd be nothing to do of an evening.
That's uncomfortably close to the truth, %1$s. I'd like it noted that I resent it.
Lost entirely. It's the one thing that keeps us all turning up to the same well.
dialogue.conversations.life.close.confid: ...You didn't have to do that. Trading is better than being asked, though. Much better.
Now we're both stood out in it. That's a fairer way round, %1$s.
Hah. You went first on the second one. I'll not forget that.
dialogue.conversations.topic.dreams.clos: I'll tell you what I want, too.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.close.conf: ...Then we're two fools with plans, and that's a better number than one.
You've got one too. Good. I'd started to think I was the only one still doing that, %1$s.
Trade you. And if either of us gets there, the other one hears about it first.
dialogue.conversations.topic.hopes.close: I'll tell you mine, if you want it.
dialogue.conversations.hopes.close.confi: ...Go on, then. It's easier to hope at something when there's two of you doing it.
You've one of your own. Of course you have. Everyone does and nobody says, %1$s.
Aye - and now we're both stood here being daft about the future. Good.
dialogue.conversations.topic.regrets.clo: I've one of my own, if it helps.
dialogue.conversations.regrets.close.con: ...You didn't owe me that. It does help. It helps more than the forgiving would have.
So there's two of us carrying something. That's not comfort exactly, but it's company, %1$s.
Hm. You put yours down next to mine instead of stepping over it. I noticed.
dialogue.conversations.topic.secret.clos: Then you should have one of mine.
dialogue.conversations.secret.close.conf: ...You'd trade. Right. Now we've each got a rope round the other's ankle, and that's how it should be.
Secrets are traded, not given - I've said that to people for years and nobody ever took me up on it, %1$s.
Go on, then. Quietly. ...There. Now neither of us can talk.
dialogue.conversations.regrets.sit_with_: ...Right. Thank you. Most of the way through that I was waiting for the sound of you leaving.
You are, aren't you. ...Give me a moment and then I'll say the rest of it, %1$s.
Still here. Aye. That's the whole of what I needed and I couldn't have asked for it.
...Aye. That's kind too, in its way. Go on.
Room. Right. I'll take the room, %1$s, and thank you for not dressing it up.
Fair enough. It's a lot to put on somebody's afternoon.
dialogue.conversations.topic.dreams.clos: You didn't promise anything. That's worth more than you'd think.
Thank you for telling me anyway.
I'll tell you what I want, too.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.close.hone: You're welcome. And you didn't dress it up as help you weren't going to give, which I'll remember.
Aye, well. An honest 'no' keeps better than a friendly 'maybe', %1$s.
Hm. Thank you for hearing it without immediately volunteering for it.
...It did. More so knowing you'd not pretend to be more use than you are.
Saying it to somebody who won't help is the purer test. It's still a want either way.
You noticed. I'd rather be heard honestly than helped carelessly, %1$s.
...Then we're two fools with plans and no obligations to each other. Perfect arrangement.
You've one of your own and you're not asking me to carry it either. Good, %1$s.
Trade you. No promises attached, on either side.
So do I. Off you go, and thank you for the honest version.
Right you are. Mind how you go, %1$s.
Aye. It'll happen or it won't, and you were straight with me about which you'd help with.
dialogue.conversations.topic.news.helped: Word gets round when somebody's been helped.
Good. That's how a village should work.
dialogue.conversations.news.helped.ask_w: Nobody will say outright. That's how you know it was done properly - quietly.
Someone passing through, by the sound of it. They didn't stay to be thanked, %1$s.
I've a guess. I'll keep it, though. Guessing out loud is how rumours start.
dialogue.conversations.news.helped.glad: It is. We're not much of a village if we only notice each other when something goes wrong.
dialogue.conversations.news.helped.glad/: Aye. One less thing hanging over somebody. That's a good week by our standards, %1$s.
That's the whole of it, isn't it. Everyone takes a turn being the one who needs it.
dialogue.conversations.news.helped.take_: ...Was it. Well. It'd have been a better story if I'd heard it from somebody else.
Hm. I'd got most of the way to admiring whoever did it, %1$s.
Aye, I'd half worked that out. You didn't have to help me finish it.
dialogue.conversations.news.helped.leave: Aye. Off you go, and mind who you tell.
Go on, then. It'll be round the whole village by morning regardless.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.late: Late to be about. I'm no better - I've been up since the fire went low.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.late/1: You're up. So am I, and neither of us has a good reason, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.late/2: This hour, the village belongs to whoever couldn't sleep. Welcome to it.
dialogue.conversations.topic.checkin.lat: It's a strange hour for company.
I'll sit up with you a while.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.late.ask_: Nothing I could name. That's the trouble - a named thing you can put down.
Tomorrow, mostly. It's very close at this hour, %1$s.
The list. Everyone's got a list and mine reads itself aloud around this time.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.late.send: ...You're right. It will keep. It always keeps and I never believe it until somebody says so.
Aye. Bed. Thank you for the shove, %1$s.
Right. Nothing at this hour ever looks the same size in the morning.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.late.keep: ...You'd sit up. With me. For no reason at all. Well. Pull the other stool over, then.
A while. Aye. It's better company than the list, %1$s.
Don't talk, mind. Just be here. That's the useful part.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.late.leav: Goodnight. Mind the step on the way, it's darker than it looks.
Sleep well, %1$s. One of us ought to.
Aye. Goodnight. It'll be morning before either of us is ready for it.
dialogue.conversations.day.rough.tense: ...Mm. Thank you. It lands a bit flat coming from you just now, but thank you.
dialogue.conversations.day.rough.tense/1: Aye. We're not quite square, you and I, but I'll take the sympathy, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.day.rough.tense/2: That's kind. There's still a thing between us, mind. But that was kind.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough.ten: ...You're asking after me. After the other week. Alright - I'll answer, and we'll see how it goes.
Hm. Asking is a start. It's not the whole of it, %1$s, but it's a start.
I'll tell you, but I'll be watching how you take it. Old habits.
dialogue.conversations.life.respond.empa: You'd know. You've been about long enough to have watched half of it happen.
It wasn't, and you were there for some of it. That's a strange comfort, %1$s.
Coming from somebody who's known me this long, that means more than it would from a stranger.
dialogue.conversations.village.respond.a: You've been here long enough to say that and mean it. Most agree out of politeness.
Aye - and you've seen it through a winter or two now, %1$s. Your opinion counts.
You'd know. You're not a visitor any more, whatever the rest of them say.
dialogue.conversations.fears.open.pledge: ...I know you will. That's the strange part - I said it and then realised I already believed it.
I'd not have told you this a year ago, %1$s. I'd not have told anyone. Hold on to that.
You don't have to promise. You've been doing it for months without the word attached.
dialogue.conversations.secret.followup.p: ...I never doubted it. I asked because saying it out loud makes it a thing between us.
Your word. I'd already have staked the whole thing on it, %1$s, but it's good to hear.
Then it's safe, and I knew it was before I opened my mouth. That's why I opened my mouth.
dialogue.conversations.day.rough.offer_h: You've done enough for one day. Sit down and let it be somebody else's turn.
Another time. You've been at it since morning, %1$s - I've been watching.
No. Kind of you, but there's a limit to how much one person should carry in a day.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough.off: You've given me plenty today. Save some of yourself for tomorrow.
Enough, %1$s. Truly. Come back tomorrow and offer again and I'll say yes.
That's twice today. I'll not have it a third time - go and do something for yourself.
We've talked it thin for one day. Come back and we'll pick it up where it is.
Enough for today. There's only so much of a thing you can say before it stops meaning anything, %1$s.
Aye. Let it rest now. It'll still be here, and so will I.
dialogue.conversations.regrets.forgive.c: ...You don't get to decide that. ...And yet something just came loose. I'll not pretend it didn't.
Say that again slowly, %1$s, because I want to remember exactly how it sounded.
dialogue.conversations.regrets.forgive.s: ...You don't. Hm. I'll keep it and see whether it holds by morning.
That's not yours to give. I'm taking it anyway.
dialogue.conversations.regrets.forgive.p: Kind. It doesn't reach the part of me that decides these things, but it's kind.
Mm. You'd say that to anybody with a long face, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.regrets.forgive.r: Don't. Absolution from somebody who wasn't there is worth exactly nothing.
You weren't in the room. You don't get to close the door on it.
dialogue.conversations.work.hear_burnout: ...It is. Nobody asks the second question, and you just did. Sit down, I've things to say.
You've been watching the man and not the work, %1$s. That's rarer than a good hammer.
...Aye. It is. That's the first time I've said so out loud.
It wears. You noticed. Right - back to it, but thank you.
Everything wears somebody down. That's not an insight, that's a job.
Mm. It's work, %1$s. It's supposed to be tiring.
Don't diagnose me across a workbench. I've been doing this longer than you've been watching.
Wearing me down. Right. Was that meant to be helpful?
dialogue.conversations.village.offer_hel: ...You mean it. Right - Tuesday, the north fence, and bring whatever you'd bring to your own.
Then you're one of us, %1$s, and I'll be telling people so.
...Aye, alright. I'll find you something that needs doing. Don't make me regret it.
Hands. Good. We're short of those and long on advice.
That's what people say. It's a fine thing to say.
Mm. I'll believe it when I see you holding the other end of something, %1$s.
We've had offers. We've had a great many offers. The fence is still down.
Don't. It's easier to offer than to turn up, and I've stopped counting the difference.
dialogue.conversations.people.encourage_: ...Talk to them. Out loud. Like people. ...I've been avoiding that for two years and you said it in six words.
You're right and I hate it, %1$s. I'll go round tomorrow. Don't watch me do it.
...I could. I've thought about it. Hearing somebody else say it makes it smaller.
Talking. Aye. It's the obvious thing and the hardest one.
You've not met them. Talking is what started it.
Easy to say from outside it, %1$s.
Don't. You've heard one side of it for two minutes and you're handing out remedies.
Have I tried talking to them. Yes. Remarkably, that occurred to me before you arrived.
dialogue.conversations.day.lighten.crit: Ha! It WAS. All day, personally, deliberately. Right - I feel better and I resent it.
dialogue.conversations.day.lighten.crit/: You're terrible. ...That's the first time I've laughed since this morning, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.day.lighten.plain: Heh. It does rather feel like that, doesn't it.
Mm. Personally, aye. That's the word for it, %1$s.
Suppose you have to laugh. Or you'd do the other thing.
dialogue.conversations.life.ask_which.lo: Which part matters. ...Today, the part where it stopped going the way I planned.
Ask me on a better day, %1$s, and you'll get a different answer to that.
All of it matters. Today none of it feels like it does. That passes, I'm told.
dialogue.conversations.hopes.listen.low: ...You'll wait. That's decent of you. I'm not sure I've got the hoping in me today, mind.
dialogue.conversations.hopes.listen.low/: It's a thin sort of hope this week, %1$s. But it's there, and you waited for it.
Give me a moment. Hoping is heavier work on days like this one.
dialogue.conversations.work.praise.high: Ha! You've caught me on a good day and I'll take every word of that.
dialogue.conversations.work.praise.high/: It has gone well, hasn't it. I'd not have said so first, but since you did, %1$s - aye!
Right you are, and don't stop there. Days like this I can take a great deal of it.
dialogue.conversations.people.defend.low: ...Perhaps. I'm in no state to be fair about them today, and you're probably right anyway.
You'd defend them. Of course you would. I'd defend them too, on a better afternoon.
Mm. Ask me tomorrow, %1$s, and I might agree with you properly.
dialogue.conversations.village.ask_impro: Improve it. Hm. Nothing springs to mind, which is either a good sign or a very bad one.
It's fine. Genuinely fine. Nobody ever wants to hear that, %1$s, but there it is.
Ask me when something's gone wrong. On an ordinary day I've no complaints ready.
dialogue.conversations.food.agree.fine: Aye. It's food. Some days that's the whole of the review.
dialogue.conversations.food.agree.fine/1: It does the job. Not everything has to be an occasion, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.food.agree.fine/2: Perfectly ordinary and perfectly sufficient. I'll not pretend otherwise.
dialogue.conversations.weather.enjoy.hig: Isn't it! I've been finding excuses to be outdoors since breakfast.
A day like this and I forget every complaint I had about this place, %1$s.
It is. Days like this are the argument for staying, and I'm having it with myself.
dialogue.conversations.season.agree.pass: Suppose so. It turns whether I notice it or not, which is rather restful.
It comes round. It always comes round. There's a comfort in the ordinariness of it, %1$s.
Aye. Nothing much to say about it, and that's rather the point of a good season.
dialogue.conversations.village.criticise: It could. I'd know - it's my name on it when it isn't. Go on, then: where would you start?
You're telling the mayor his village could be run better. ...Bold. And not wrong, %1$s.
I've a list of my own that long. The trouble is which end to pick it up by.
Exhausting. You've no idea. They cross the lane when they see me coming.
It is. Though I'll grant they've their reasons, %1$s, which is the tiring part.
Aye. Try living alongside people who've decided what you are already.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.glad.hurt: ...You're bleeding. Sit down before you tell me how well you're doing.
Glad, are you. You look like you lost an argument with something large, %1$s.
Don't 'glad' me. Something's had a go at you. Sit.
dialogue.conversations.village.ask_impro: We've a smith, which puts us ahead of most. What we've not got is a decent road to reach her by.
The forge is the best thing here. Everything else could learn from it, %1$s.
With a smith we can mend what breaks. It's the things nobody can mend that want the work.
dialogue.conversations.work.ask_why.harv: Why? In %1$s you don't ask why. You ask whether it's in yet, and it isn't.
Ask me that in a quieter season, %1$s. Right now the answer is 'because it'll rot otherwise'.
This time of year the work does the asking and I just answer it.
dialogue.conversations.work.praise.storm: Kind of you to say it standing out in this. Get under something.
Praise in a downpour counts double, %1$s. Now go inside.
Ha! You've picked a filthy afternoon to be complimentary. I'll take it.
dialogue.conversations.village.agree.win: In %1$s you find out what a village is actually made of. This one holds.
Ask me again in spring and I'll be less sentimental about it, %1$s.
It's the cold months that prove it. Anyone can like a place in summer.
dialogue.conversations.food.ask_recipe.s: In %1$s? Whatever's ripe, barely cooked, eaten standing up. That's the recipe.
There's no recipe this time of year, %1$s. There's just what came in that morning.
The trick is to do less to it. Everything's already good right now.
More? It's %1$s. I've been eating since dawn and I intend to continue.
On a day like today, %1$s, the answer to 'how are you' is always 'full'.
Everything's better today and I'm not going to examine why too closely.
dialogue.conversations.weather.talk_crop: Not a cloud. %1$s like this is what you pray for and then immediately worry about.
It's fine growing weather, %1$s. Three more days of it and I'll start complaining about drought.
Clear sky, no wind, everything doing what it should. Suspicious, frankly.
dialogue.conversations.season.ask_favour: Favourite? None of them, particularly. It's just the ordinary middle of the year.
There's no festival to point at, %1$s. Just the days going by, which suits me.
The ones with nothing happening in them. Those are underrated.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.glad.grat: Better than I was — that %1$s you brought me is still doing its work.
Well enough. I've the %1$s you gave me on the shelf where I can see it.
Good, and partly because of the %1$s. I've not forgotten.
...More. Right. I've been trying to think of a reason to keep you here and you've handed me one.
You want the long version? From you, %1$s, you can have the very long version.
Ask me anything. Honestly. Ask me about the weather and I'd talk for an hour.
dialogue.conversations.work_offer.ask_la: Nothing today - and after the last thing you did for me, I'd almost be embarrassed to ask.
Come back tomorrow, %1$s. You've done enough for this village to be going on with.
Not just now. I'm still telling people about the last one.
